654a906e6758ffe17974dae829d35423dcd827b3.summary: Muse Spark 1.3 withdrawn due to upstream `404 model_not_found` errors. Muse Spark 1.2 replaces it in the free model picker and CLI. Saved 1.2 preferences migrate to 1.3 on load.

26f374dc2bc2abd17e24eabe0c254e426e49d350.summary: Muse Spark 1.3 is restored and replaces Muse Spark 1.2 in the free model picker on Web, CLI, and Desktop. Saved preferences for Muse Spark 1.2 are automatically migrated to Muse Spark 1.3. Muse Spark 1.2 remains available for existing live sessions and installed builds but is retired from new selections.

b0ec8028c8fa97b1e285eb8739988689b8520e7d.title: Refactor slash command filter, export function
b0ec8028c8fa97b1e285eb8739988689b8520e7d.summary: Refactored `filterSlashCommands` in `cli/src/hooks/use-suggestion-engine.ts` to use a shared `matchByIdOrAlias` helper for prefix and substring matching. Function exported.

217906d84aa2113d8c363debba204695a6e074db.title: Landing screen shows auto top-up URL
217906d84aa2113d8c363debba204695a6e074db.summary: Updated CLI landing screen to display auto top-up URL on rate limit errors.

2e67ad0b60df355424e672d6a635b6d5ab2cdad8.title: Document freebuff-web prod-smoke, harness, Node pin
2e67ad0b60df355424e672d6a635b6d5ab2cdad8.summary: Added docs for `freebuff/web` prod-smoke gate. Clarified shared harness responsibilities. Explained per-service Node version pinning.

a8d0c1a83f4dc3677069dec06aca8a2aa3bdfb20.title: Solar Pro 4 pricing logic updated; promo ends
a8d0c1a83f4dc3677069dec06aca8a2aa3bdfb20.summary: Updated internal pricing comments for Solar Pro 4 to reflect that the 90% discount is a permanent rate, not a temporary promo. Added a scheduled change to revert the model to its regular metered price starting 2026-09-13.

4897491493104492eafbdca91dfd2ccda3c00020.title: Add live smoke test docs; support env file injection in e2e sessions
4897491493104492eafbdca91dfd2ccda3c00020.summary: Documented live production smoke test procedure in `freebuff/e2e/README.md`. Updated `freebuff-session.ts` to support optional environment variables written to a secure temp file, preventing secret leakage into indexed project directories.

3cb1fb6862cca34e8ccbba778c11ca697e2a9e05.title: Add production-runtime smoke test docs for web
3cb1fb6862cca34e8ccbba778c11ca697e2a9e05.summary: Documented new `build-web` smoke test running production code under Node to catch runtime API mismatches (e.g., `Promise.withResolvers`). Includes local execution instructions using `bun run smoke:prod` against a loopback Postgres.

72627b4a8b54f0f2fb08b872d0ad770891b87e24.title: Subscription cost report gains observed hours and forecast window fields
72627b4a8b54f0f2fb08b872d0ad770891b87e24.summary: Updated `SubscriptionCostReport` in `common/src/types/subscription-costs.ts` to include optional `observedHours` for completed covered hours, plus `forecastObservationStart` and `forecastObservationEnd` to separate complete-day forecast basis from recent measurements. Documentation updated to reflect completed-hour reporting instead of UTC-day coverage.

51e6c7bcf02623bda9cd8faa187aad7ffeaad37e.title: Add SubscriptionCostMetrics and SubscriptionCostReport types
51e6c7bcf02623bda9cd8faa187aad7ffeaad37e.summary: New TypeScript interfaces `SubscriptionCostMetrics` and `SubscriptionCostReport` added to `common/src/types/subscription-costs.ts`. These define the shape for tracking provider costs, attribution status, and 30-day forecasts for paid subscribers.

0e7e3934db90c7866404ed431039233bc6f1a628.title: CLI path helper use non-throwing root getter
0e7e3934db90c7866404ed431039233bc6f1a628.summary: Switched `getRelativePath` to `tryGetProjectRoot`. Prevents crashes when project root unset during startup or tests. Internal refactor.

dedd70d5414f7b9b98050623b74a4fa850669e1b.title: read_files now returns images as media
dedd70d5414f7b9b98050623b74a4fa850669e1b.summary: The `read_files` tool detects image paths and returns base64 media parts instead of text bytes. This allows the AI to visually analyze images in the project. Hosts without local binary read support continue to receive image paths as text.

aa93519f568da1f67f76245d2f2c9e8724ad9ebb.title: Sponsored compute acceptance price configurable via env
aa93519f568da1f67f76245d2f2c9e8724ad9ebb.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_SPONSORED_COMPUTE_ACCEPTANCE_PRICE_CENTS` to `SponsoredComputePolicyEnv`. `readSponsoredComputePolicy` now validates this price, defaulting to 200 cents if absent. Malformed prices return null, blocking admission.

a784cf2d81b03b3074f794fb5acdcfcb18ef35fd.title: Add house subscription billing A/B experiment utilities
a784cf2d81b03b3074f794fb5acdcfcb18ef35fd.summary: Added `HOUSE_SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_EXPERIMENT` constant, `parseHouseSubscriptionBillingExperimentMode`, and `houseSubscriptionBillingArmForUser` to `common/src/util/ad-experiment.ts`. These functions provide deterministic, sticky 50/50 assignment between 'monthly' and 'yearly' billing arms for users.

a7ea9ca1fdbf59aea2aedd91b557f4416f19695b.title: Add Gravity Showcase experiment types and analytics events
a7ea9ca1fdbf59aea2aedd91b557f4416f19695b.summary: New `gravity-showcase-experiment.ts` types define A/B test structure and assignment logic. Added `ADS_SHOWCASE_PRESENTED` analytics event and corresponding telemetry validation in `axiom-only-log.ts` and `log-ingest.ts`.

5f024bab305902dc778d74b92756ae6c96cb42f4.title: Raise default ad credit line to $200
5f024bab305902dc778d74b92756ae6c96cb42f4.summary: Default postpaid credit line doubled to $200. Added $100 collection threshold before delivery stops. Growth step minimum fixed to $100.

ebc17a50dc3d760f6d6eb023df4abc508e1dbd9f.title: Add yearly billing support to subscription types
ebc17a50dc3d760f6d6eb023df4abc508e1dbd9f.summary: Added `yearlyPriceUsd` to subscription tiers and `yearlyPriceUsd` to tier offers. Introduced billing interval constants and type guards. Updated `FreebuffSubscriptionInfo` to include `source`, `billingInterval`, and `renewsAt` fields for better client-side handling of subscription states.

1fe7bfe3bb89a5f39ce493861f57c861565e81ed.title: Session types: concurrency + slotLimit in admission response
1fe7bfe3bb89a5f39ce493861f57c861565e81ed.summary: Added `concurrency` and `slotLimit` fields to `FreebuffSessionAdmissionResponse` capacity refusal type. Imported `FreebuffDesktopConcurrency` type. Optional fields; older servers omit them.

1dd01919a42648d9da8f473c4f84b3b0b55b8605.title: Remove unused validation error formatting util

871e0ef0f989d23273c778f4b30eb541c6d0deed.title: Bump freebuff CLI version to 0.0.173
871e0ef0f989d23273c778f4b30eb541c6d0deed.summary: Updated the version number in the release `package.json` to 0.0.173.

4aa36c7b25c32bdc0605e5abfc8529e306dc4dd7.title: Add iOS ad placements to Freebuff
4aa36c7b25c32bdc0605e5abfc8529e306dc4dd7.summary: Introduced `ios-placements.ts` to define native iOS ad slots for chat and coding flows. Updated `freebuff-placements.ts` to include these iOS placements alongside existing web slots.

af898dcad679dbbd27389aef8a674cee31d58d43.title: Allow BYOK resume for hosted sessions
af898dcad679dbbd27389aef8a674cee31d58d43.summary: SDK now permits switching from hosted inference to BYOK when resuming a session. Previously, any source mismatch blocked the run.

2c8541e90dcc9e7641fe7d4ba7c03e1eea64bfa4.title: Clarify spend label; expose modelSpendUsd type
2c8541e90dcc9e7641fe7d4ba7c03e1eea64bfa4.summary: Updated `FREEBUFF_SPEND_UNIT_LABEL` to "model spend" for clarity. Added optional `modelSpendUsd` field to `FreebuffRecentUsage` type.

175ea48e5f9acebbb528cd76425d4f268f0d947c.title: CLI: Add BYOK support
175ea48e5f9acebbb528cd76425d4f268f0d947c.summary: New `/byok` command allows using custom provider keys via environment variables. Selecting a BYOK connection bypasses Freebuff auth, ads, and session limits.

385a72397d899dcd80b9715f1b86adff24faa644.title: CLI: Wallet consent flow, balance unavailable state, session expiry checks
385a72397d899dcd80b9715f1b86adff24faa644.summary: Added `consent_required` session state and pending wallet consent logic to `use-freebuff-session.ts`. `startFreebuffSession` now accepts `walletSpendLimit`. Model selector shows 'balance temporarily unavailable' when `freebucks` is null, and validates active session expiry before allowing switches. New `freebuff-model-selection.ts` utility added.

0cbff57aed44d5a012b9dbb93912884ba1be0ccc.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash replaces V4 Flash in free model picker
0cbff57aed44d5a012b9dbb93912884ba1be0ccc.summary: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash replaces DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31 in the free model catalog. CLI selector now displays server-driven upgrade offers for limited-tier users.

6bfe1fe6644c350a1d13259cd4141c316e57e1ac.title: Clarify purchased Desktop session pause messaging
6bfe1fe6644c350a1d13259cd4141c316e57e1ac.summary: Added `purchasesPaused` flag to session admission responses to distinguish server-side purchase pauses from model outages. Updated client-side labels to explicitly state that the model is fine and purchased sessions are temporarily paused, preventing users from incorrectly assuming the selected model is unavailable.

bf468de5940335611a1669118edb2540e6618f6e.title: Extend Desktop idle release to 15m, add session headers
bf468de5940335611a1669118edb2540e6618f6e.summary: Increased `FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_IDLE_RELEASE_MS` from 10 to 15 minutes. Added `x-freebuff-desktop-admitted-at` and `x-freebuff-desktop-attempt-id` constants for stable tab tracking and unacknowledged POST identification.

2570b57ebdbf98f703cd9515379d76615eb48e4a.title: Update house ad copy, add after-hours artwork
2570b57ebdbf98f703cd9515379d76615eb48e4a.summary: Added new `freebuff-pro-after-hours` WebP artwork and markdown documentation for the subscription campaign. Updated `Desktop-Spotlight` and `Desktop-Showcase` ad variations to reuse approved campaign copy, replacing previous session-count specific text.

f48d871ed62bc99da5c8486f58e5847750fcb2fd.title: Thinker agent switched to GPT-5.6 Luna, reasoning effort expanded
f48d871ed62bc99da5c8486f58e5847750fcb2fd.summary: The Chat thinker agent now uses GPT-5.6 Luna with extra-high reasoning instead of DeepSeek V4 Flash. Reasoning effort levels `max` and `xhigh` added to agent definition types.

5f45bd81450eb50ba253ec315e067f798771d98a.title: Set Solar Pro 4 price to 0 Freebucks
5f45bd81450eb50ba253ec315e067f798771d98a.summary: Added price change transition for Solar Pro 4 to 0 Freebucks. Updated comments to reflect historical price preservation.

c8894546fb126b852322d188c60fd21efc9a0faa.title: Clarify update-required message for old Desktop builds
c8894546fb126b852322d188c60fd21efc9a0faa.summary: Server now flags `updateRequired` when old Desktop builds can't resume purchased time. New messages clarify model is fine, update needed, no extra charge.

4cb83e770ab4290df3813b4526fcd55978f5a323.title: CLI shows plain-English errors for sponsored task refusals
4cb83e770ab4290df3813b4526fcd55978f5a323.summary: CLI now translates internal error codes into user-friendly sentences for sponsored task refusals. Added a central registry for Supabase format experiment campaign pairs to prevent configuration drift.

cc9069e251e8fedd5784c688ce78ccfecd76815f.title: Sponsored procedure runtime inputs
cc9069e251e8fedd5784c688ce78ccfecd76815f.summary: Sponsored runs now pass advertiser CTA URL as separate runtime input. Procedure text stays unaltered to preserve consent hash. CLI displays sanitized advertiser link if present.

81f78e0c885af9edb97960bf8e8497cf1a45e6a1.title: Ignore GHA OIDC credentials
81f78e0c885af9edb97960bf8e8497cf1a45e6a1.summary: Added `gha-creds-*.json` to `.gitignore` to prevent accidental commits of short-lived GitHub OIDC credentials.

b816aed976efe357204d4878122710062c89ec89.title: Add purchase continuity claim types and refund metadata
b816aed976efe357204d4878122710062c89ec89.summary: Introduce `purchase_claim_released`, `purchase_in_use`, and `purchase_capacity` session statuses. Add `FREEBUFF_PURCHASE_CONTINUITY_HEADER` for single-use execution claims. Extend API responses with `desktopPurchases` and `desktopRefunds` metadata.

54ba9b4874e7b588f9f771155853fa42e2218765.title: Version bump to 0.0.172
54ba9b4874e7b588f9f771155853fa42e2218765.summary: Updated CLI package version from 0.0.171 to 0.0.172.

e9ebac6cb68071c635ef41d4d6807073a57b513c.title: Forward resolved client IP to Imprezia ad requests
e9ebac6cb68071c635ef41d4d6807073a57b513c.summary: Added `clientIp` parameter to `fetchImpreziaChatAd` and `fetchImpreziaDisplayAd`. Server now forwards single resolved end-user IP via `X-Forwarded-For` header to Imprezia API. Improves ad targeting accuracy and fraud detection.

df46a33ebe7178f9f9a56740f859e846215f982d.title: Switch Solar Pro 4 to non-ZDR endpoint
df46a33ebe7178f9f9a56740f859e846215f982d.summary: Solar Pro 4 now uses `upstage` instead of `upstage/zdr` for debugging. Data use remains 'service' with training traces disabled.

a8def7f03d62efcc46ff246bb83a69443036aa27.title: Remove unused agent message tree helpers
a8def7f03d62efcc46ff246bb83a69443036aa27.summary: Deleted `getDescendantIds`, `getAncestorIds`, and `isAgentVisible` from `cli/src/utils/message-tree-utils.ts`. These internal helper functions are no longer used in the codebase.

358336a18e557894e7bbdd623c43e34f1bc54f6f.title: CLI v1.0.688
358336a18e557894e7bbdd623c43e34f1bc54f6f.summary: Version bump to 1.0.688. No user-facing changes.

17106e2e4b02aee3ffa07db72fad3327df43b1b2.title: CLI shows refund status and updates end-session description
17106e2e4b02aee3ffa07db72fad3327df43b1b2.summary: CLI now displays refund pending and completed status in landing screen. `/end-session` description updated to mention 90% cost refund. Session release logic moved to store with refund polling support.

abd1eed4ab8de4111232935a21962b5a03ff5a33.title: Fix accidental model selection and unresponsive priced-out rows
abd1eed4ab8de4111232935a21962b5a03ff5a33.summary: Resolved a critical bug where dismissing the Freebucks intro card accidentally started a session on the cheapest model. Fixed an issue where model rows that were too expensive for the user's balance did not respond to clicks or Enter, preventing access to pricing info.

6e661ec6984d33a02c3a592348b160d68dacfee3.title: New common/constants/freebuff-earn.ts
6e661ec6984d33a02c3a592348b160d68dacfee3.summary: Added `common/src/constants/freebuff-earn.ts`. Refactored CLI referral banner to import earn constants from new module.

92c4f5ef87df3e074a688d0c635c551b51d46b37.title: Muse Spark 1.3 removed, 1.2 added to free model picker
92c4f5ef87df3e074a688d0c635c551b51d46b37.summary: Muse Spark 1.3 is withdrawn from the free model picker due to persistent `404 model_not_found` errors across all keys. Muse Spark 1.2 replaces it on all surfaces (Web, CLI, Desktop). Muse Spark 1.3 is paused to prevent retry loops for existing clients.

7539eacf2a73bfcbfdb5e37cf88fdcc494361cf5.title: Add error body to Imprezia client logs
7539eacf2a73bfcbfdb5e37cf88fdcc494361cf5.summary: The `postToImprezia` function now captures and logs the response body (truncated to 300 chars) when an API error occurs. This provides visibility into rejected fields and causes for failed ad fetches.

95e3f5f94d99ac80eeac8306d46296208263d5bd.title: Restore premium session limit to 5
95e3f5f94d99ac80eeac8306d46296208263d5bd.summary: Reverted `FREEBUFF_PREMIUM_SESSION_LIMIT` and tier-specific `premiumSessionsPerDay` from 4 back to 5. Removed `FREEBUFF_PRE_LEVELS_PREMIUM_SESSION_LIMIT` and `FREEBUFF_PRE_LEVELS_LIMITED_SESSION_LIMIT` constants as the Levels feature is retired.

04578916f453fcab40ef1d5dac060e94ab126108.title: Peak-pricing badge in model selector
04578916f453fcab40ef1d5dac060e94ab126108.summary: Adds peak-pricing badge to model selector with tooltip showing surcharge and end time in local timezone. New `freebuff-peak-price.ts` util exports `isFreebucksPeakModel` and `freebucksPeakCopy`. `FreebuffFreebucksPeak` type added to session types.

3e63daca691768e95055f250f95cdf1404b251ad.title: Remove daily spend ceilings, add session pacing
3e63daca691768e95055f250f95cdf1404b251ad.summary: Deprecated per-account daily spend limits (`FREEBUFF_DAILY_SPEND_USD`) and `turn_spend_limit` errors. Replaced hard refusals with soft session pacing targets. Fixed 409 response parsing bug in session API.

5454338099733607d45ae7442117bf2879569637.title: Limited tier hero switches to GLM 5.3 Flash
5454338099733607d45ae7442117bf2879569637.summary: Freebuff now recommends GLM 5.3 Flash as the default hero model for limited-access users. DeepSeek V4 Flash remains the internal coercion target to ensure fallback safety if the meter rolls back.

f396f4ef37618acc07c9b6c7e461695e3d357e72.title: Freebuff daily compute cap raised to 4x Freebucks value
f396f4ef37618acc07c9b6c7e461695e3d357e72.summary: Updated `FREEBUFF_FREEBUCKS_CEILING_NOTICE` constant. Daily compute cap increased from 3x to 4x Freebucks value.

8d21e42dbfa0c7509ffc294601a55f9a95a2cd25.title: Update turn spend limit error message
8d21e42dbfa0c7509ffc294601a55f9a95a2cd25.summary: Rewrote `FREEBUFF_TURN_SPEND_LIMIT_MESSAGE` to be concise. Removed internal diagnostic details about agent loops. Clarified that session remains available for new messages.

f1ebb9710b9ba26d96f19a1cf8e6fb2e2ae71c8b.title: Add ads.mcp_tool_call event to Axiom-only logging
f1ebb9710b9ba26d96f19a1cf8e6fb2e2ae71c8b.summary: Introduced `ads.mcp_tool_call` event type with allowlisted fields for advertiser MCP operation census. Content-free logging of tool, outcome, error code, and duration.

ec6003e6dc37caba65b92c4eca3adb7595eca4e3.title: Version bump to 0.0.171
ec6003e6dc37caba65b92c4eca3adb7595eca4e3.summary: Updated release package version from 0.0.170 to 0.0.171.

4972f1e7a75e6c7f2421c55040c0746c9e5d97da.title: Fix false spend ceiling rejections for Freebucks meter
4972f1e7a75e6c7f2421c55040c0746c9e5d97da.summary: ResolveFreebuffSpendCeiling now skips `elevated_country` and `trust_level` limits when `onFreebucksMeter` is true. This prevents valid accounts from being incorrectly blocked by legacy budget cohorts.

54ce330ea151686b4a999b1318617b6c6a069644.title: Show Freebucks daily reset countdown in CLI model selector
54ce330ea151686b4a999b1318617b6c6a069644.summary: Added a countdown timer (e.g., "resets in 4h 12m") to the Freebucks header line in the CLI model selector. This helps users track when their daily Freebucks allowance refills, matching the behavior on Web and Desktop.

872fc2305848cdcdd0e5d4199e211b9f82831fe1.title: Advertiser redaction v2: country codes visible
872fc2305848cdcdd0e5d4199e211b9f82831fe1.summary: Added `country_excluded` and `country_unresolved` to operator, safe, and visible reason codes. Bumped `ADVERTISER_REASON_REDACTION_VERSION` to `v2`. Users now see specific country refusal reasons.

253ee6c497c3d67371a7cddabfeacaebb19e308a.title: Free model spend no longer drains daily allowance
253ee6c497c3d67371a7cddabfeacaebb19e308a.summary: Added logic to exempt spend on models currently offered for free from the user's daily dollar allowance. This prevents using free-tier models from locking users out of paid features due to budget limits.

52fa3fb94d1b2957fdefa82afae8158a0ae19cff.title: Untrack local config files
52fa3fb94d1b2957fdefa82afae8158a0ae19cff.summary: Added `.env.local.example`, `xcuserdata/`, and `.claude/settings.local.json` to `.gitignore`. Ensures local environment and IDE-specific settings are not committed.

02ec3583806e4bf811825a7f7bc3a1082c4583d3.title: Added Freebuff Pro sponsor break hero assets and copy
02ec3583806e4bf811825a7f7bc3a1082c4583d3.summary: Added new SVG and PNG hero assets for Freebuff Pro sponsor breaks. Updated core constants to include specific ad creatives and placement IDs for Desktop Spotlight and Showcase breaks.

78d1eebe0a27ffa9f8d4d3b6d38261f19d5acd11.title: CLI release 1.0.687
78d1eebe0a27ffa9f8d4d3b6d38261f19d5acd11.summary: Published CLI version 1.0.687. No functional changes.

a4b3d0fa55c77663581617e15840fb467c110159.title: Add accent span parser and placement format labels
a4b3d0fa55c77663581617e15840fb467c110159.summary: New `common/src/ads/accent-span.ts` module parses, validates, and strips `*word*` accent markup for sponsor breaks. `freebuff-placements.ts` adds explicit format labels for Desktop/CLI slots and frequency copy. CLI version bumped to 0.0.170.

d3d99f4c5a6e4bc6fbb83c81ea8b7a63cb53e0b4.title: Version bump to 0.0.169
d3d99f4c5a6e4bc6fbb83c81ea8b7a63cb53e0b4.summary: Updated package version in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` from `0.0.168` to `0.0.169`.

c4093bf714387f3c5bda94d19d5181c0543054e1.title: CLI: clearer usage-limit copy, day-scale reset, carry Freebucks block
c4093bf714387f3c5bda94d19d5181c0543054e1.summary: Landing screen now says "Daily usage cap reached" for metered accounts, formats long waits as days, and reworded reset/upgrade lines. Refusal responses carry the held Freebucks block so the meter renders correctly. Hard-ceiling notice rewritten.

fb0ab0941b7c17b23b57e0d950f836d852c4d912.title: CLI Freebucks meter: monthly usage, referral copy
fb0ab0941b7c17b23b57e0d950f836d852c4d912.summary: Landing screen shows monthly usage limit and reset time when metered. Referral banner simplified to Freebucks copy for metered accounts. Header line labels Freebucks and monthly usage.

76a5696e5fdd93b9dc8dded8d2d0c8fac82937ab.title: Default model switched to GLM 5.3 Flash
76a5696e5fdd93b9dc8dded8d2d0c8fac82937ab.summary: GLM 5.3 Flash is now the default model for all users, replacing DeepSeek V4 Flash. The model picker order and documentation have been updated to reflect this change.

e6c61f451394b49df437af776c496a0365474fd6.title: Solar Pro 4 free Labor Day weekend promo
e6c61f451394b49df437af776c496a0365474fd6.summary: Solar Pro 4 costs 0 Freebucks Sep 5–7 (PT). CLI model selector updates prices live as server schedule transitions occur.

2cd4966460ec52724504da1424e2aaa7f56b6e95.title: Add sponsor break event validator and interrupting placement predicates
2cd4966460ec52724504da1424e2aaa7f56b6e95.summary: Adds `isSponsorBreakEvent` to validate untrusted event names against the closed set. Introduces `isInterruptingBreakFormat` and `isInterruptingBreakPlacement` to distinguish screen-interrupting formats (spotlight, intermission) from non-interrupting ones (showcase) for correct daily cap application. Updates `dismiss_lock_ms` documentation to clarify shared usage across formats.

b9d72aecc22730807ca4c2d450c9f9b1c0c6739b.title: Add sponsor break dismiss lock metrics
b9d72aecc22730807ca4c2d450c9f9b1c0c6739b.summary: New event fields `dismiss_lock_ms` and `lock_completed` added to sponsor break payloads. Internal utility `clampSponsorBreakDismissLockMs` added to bound lock duration (0-5s).

4ac0d8ab8584d5ada8c2f0bda35ab6b7c974e02f.title: GLM 5.3 Flash gains limited access; Freebucks metering in CLI
4ac0d8ab8584d5ada8c2f0bda35ab6b7c974e02f.summary: README updates show GLM 5.3 Flash now available for limited access users. CLI session summaries and model selectors integrate `getFreebuffModelMeter` to display Freebucks balances and model-specific quotas alongside legacy session limits.

Bonus retirement logic clarified: occurs on new credit or upgrade, not solely at subscription end.

e8a3c7930b8024d099e2c2abf75ff582798a73c9.title: Fix limited-region model catalog leak. Gemini 3.8 Flash now Pro-only.
e8a3c7930b8024d099e2c2abf75ff582798a73c9.summary: Corrects model access logic for limited-region users. GPT-5.6 Luna remains free for full-access users but locked for limited regions. Gemini 3.8 Flash is now strictly Pro-only across all tiers.

6c846b9d1e27bda1da35cfbe900f062eefb7e2b2.title: CLI: Freebucks meter UI, intro card, price sort
6c846b9d1e27bda1da35cfbe900f062eefb7e2b2.summary: Added Freebucks intro card on landing. Model selector sorts cheapest-first when metered. Rate limit screen shows Freebucks shortfall vs session limit.

88e05db4b26f8e58eca99dbae7cf8ef26f22d0a5.title: Add sponsor break ad event tracking and placement formats
88e05db4b26f8e58eca99dbae7cf8ef26f22d0a5.summary: New internal telemetry definitions for sponsor break ads (show, close, click events with dwell time and close method) and placement format types (inline, showcase, spotlight, intermission). This lays the groundwork for measuring sponsor break ad performance.

b8a55e9b61345917b0f8b470e4c02ab4f4956d4f.title: Add sponsored compute contract, remove API key from logs
b8a55e9b61345917b0f8b470e4c02ab4f4956d4f.summary: Introduced `sponsored-compute-contract.ts` defining types and policy validation for sponsored compute grants. Removed `apiKey` from error logging in `getUserInfoFromApiKey` to prevent credential leakage. Added optional `conversationId` to `SponsoredProposalRow`.

f1654d2c20dcf2cc75a464b7c6707d1cfeef6711.title: Solar Pro 4 no longer experimental
f1654d2c20dcf2cc75a464b7c6707d1cfeef6711.summary: Removed `experimental: true` from `SOLAR_PRO_4_MODEL` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`. Model treated as stable.

d4ee9ca285c94e9348a7da806a9d2b7ecc69807b.title: New sponsor dock panel in CLI chat
d4ee9ca285c94e9348a7da806a9d2b7ecc69807b.summary: Added expandable detail panel for inline sponsor ads. Users can toggle via click, chord key, or Escape. Panel auto-collapses on send or when takeover screens activate.

3de218cfbec42f26a76cf460205d0a5727735c10.title: CLI: Handle sponsored proposal refresh failures gracefully
3de218cfbec42f26a76cf460205d0a5727735c10.summary: When a sponsored proposal fails to refresh (e.g. offline), the CLI now displays a clear 'Could not refresh' message and disables interactive controls (Accept, Menu, Dismiss) to prevent invalid actions. This ensures UI consistency and prevents errors when network connectivity is lost.

20289ffb12000c10fd26cd3735849066e963d1cc.title: Add click_id_shape validation to external conversion postback logs
20289ffb12000c10fd26cd3735849066e963d1cc.summary: New `click_id_shape` field added to `ADS_EXTERNAL_CONVERSION_POSTBACK_EVENT` to record why S2S postbacks fail click-id shape guards. Values are strictly limited to `missing`, `wrong_type`, `empty`, `oversized`, or `control_char` to prevent leaking sensitive request data.

d573b4d0977a99b5bea28768a03e3731c51343f5.title: Add Supabase ad format experiment logic
d573b4d0977a99b5bea28768a03e3731c51343f5.summary: New internal module defines eligibility checks and arm assignment for a Supabase acquisition format experiment. Supports A/B testing between display and agentic ad formats.

7b211367021e612630a9c1040fea39abdc157e45.title: Plan mode hardens toolset, prompt, and examples
7b211367021e612630a9c1040fea39abdc157e45.summary: Plan mode now enforces read-only behavior by removing write and shell tools (str_replace, write_file, basher, tmux-cli, editor) from the agent toolset and gating spawn instructions. The worked example in the system prompt was split so plan mode ends with writing a <PLAN> block and refusing to implement, instead of demonstrating a build. Explore prompt also drops bashers when plan-only.

9f81f91397709452f3b757a035fb9e93d0ab9454.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash returns as Pro-only Web model
9f81f91397709452f3b757a035fb9e93d0ab9454.summary: Gemini 3.8 Flash removed from paused free list. Now gated behind Pro subscription on Web only. CLI and Desktop unaffected. Subscription plan model lists consolidated to prevent drift.

f3857f1b81fa3b21e59eba6564a47a8edb64c5f3.title: Add reason redaction, CPC band, ingress evidence log
f3857f1b81fa3b21e59eba6564a47a8edb64c5f3.summary: Added `advertiser-reason-redaction.ts` to project operator reasons into a safe advertiser vocabulary, hiding sensitive data. Introduced `advertiserPlacementCpcBand` for editable CPC limits. New `ads.campaign_ingress_evidence_v1` event added to logging schema.

e2b7fe5a4ebe36206150cc194cc297fc0c8bd251.title: Gravity user agent resolution fix
e2b7fe5a4ebe36206150cc194cc297fc0c8bd251.summary: Added `resolveGravityUserAgent` to prioritize real client user agents for Gravity, preventing ~74% of traffic from being misreported as Chrome desktop. Falls back to browser-like UA only if header is missing.

8fafc97b35aa47a8dcea952690e2a8bf115f2da8.title: Increase Muse Spark fallback delay to 15s
8fafc97b35aa47a8dcea952690e2a8bf115f2da8.summary: The wait time before Muse Spark falls back to DeepSeek V4 Flash increased from 10 to 15 seconds. This adjustment accommodates the new key pool logic, ensuring users wait only when all keys are exhausted rather than during normal rate-limit handling.

df4b9aa599930aa2b2b9b2bd283089261c4d445d.title: Added Imprezia third-party tracker delivery module
df4b9aa599930aa2b2b9b2bd283089261c4d445d.summary: New `common/src/util/imprezia-trackers.ts` handles fire-and-forget delivery of advertiser measurement pixels and frames on end-user devices. Updated `imprezia-client.ts` to log tracker channels for better impression debugging.

d9ecc85e1636aa3b8fc950f42de71c3ec8da7250.title: Muse Spark 1.3 added to CLI and Desktop free model picker
d9ecc85e1636aa3b8fc950f42de71c3ec8da7250.summary: Meta's Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor model is now available in the free model catalog for CLI and Desktop surfaces, previously Web-only. The model features a 1M context window and uses a shared rate-limited pool; when busy, it queues or falls back to DeepSeek V4 Flash to ensure responsiveness.

2476a76f4dd8eb14dba89d848e676146c839a7e5.title: Add metric field to ads settlement logging
2476a76f4dd8eb14dba89d848e676146c839a7e5.summary: Added `metric: 'string'` to `ADS_FIRST_PARTY_SETTLEMENT_FIELDS` in `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts`. Enables metric tracking in settlement logs.

bb9e8822ea946d45870d09ff2ad8db35f872bbda.title: Doc clarification: Freebucks wallet expiry logic
bb9e8822ea946d45870d09ff2ad8db35f872bbda.summary: Updated comments in `freebuff-session.ts` to explain how the wallet distinguishes between permanent earned Freebucks and expiring monthly bonuses, and clarifies spending priority.

09fa12bf061ab808dd43735fc2de7beb5288e441.title: Fix stuck turn retry loop
09fa12bf061ab808dd43735fc2de7beb5288e441.summary: Turn spend limit errors no longer trigger useless retries. CLI shows specific message telling user to send new message.

23c15cfd4656c6eb305dfe9e4bbab938ebadbed8.title: Add ads.advertiser_reporting_read event
23c15cfd4656c6eb305dfe9e4bbab938ebadbed8.summary: Added new logging event `ads.advertiser_reporting_read` to track advertiser reporting reads. Includes allowlisted fields for advertiser ID, endpoint, range, and outcome.

6e53c6db1674d4f343f2392092a6f316fa9644fb.title: Add server access tier resolver
6e53c6db1674d4f343f2392092a6f316fa9644fb.summary: Added `getFreebuffServerAccessTier` helper to extract server-decided access tier from session payloads. Ensures UI labels match allowance calculations when client-side resolution differs.

f25d4059b88ff4bdca2e120522d0970fb8d2d103.title: CLI: Monthly rate limit copy; Shared/Core: Monthly allowance types
f25d4059b88ff4bdca2e120522d0970fb8d2d103.summary: CLI landing screen displays 'this month' for pacific_month period. Shared/Core types add FreebuffMonthlyAllowance interface and pacific_month period value.

bd9237b1808e650373ecd6303080a5f3c29e1071.title: Remove Gemini 3.8 Flash from free model picker
bd9237b1808e650373ecd6303080a5f3c29e1071.summary: Gemini 3.8 Flash withdrawn from free mode due to reliability and speed issues. Removed from model catalog and READMEs.

8870810f21a3f99ee8e7f349bd10e1dce92488d2.title: Widen limited-region Web model catalog
8870810f21a3f99ee8e7f349bd10e1dce92488d2.summary: Limited-region Freebuff Web users now access the full free catalog (minus GPT-5.6 Luna). This allows spending daily Freebucks allowance on cheaper, higher-value models like GLM 5.3 Flash.

0f33961336a021a0fe9943aa72144fec1183c3ab.title: Add funnel event types: dismissed, run_failed, run_committed
0f33961336a021a0fe9943aa72144fec1183c3ab.summary: Three new event types added to `AGENTIC_FUNNEL_EVENT_TYPES` for better tracking of proposal dismissals, failed runs, and committed work. Strict append-only rule enforced to match Postgres enum migration constraints.

3160888e27f2fb25238fef56ff8e67b9d8d1f5ea.title: Fixtures add default logo token
3160888e27f2fb25238fef56ff8e67b9d8d1f5ea.summary: Updated shared test fixtures to include default advertiser logo tokens. Clarified token resolution behavior in comments.

6470ff421860de64df4196f6891f11470625bce0.title: CLI ad telemetry: event deduplication, render delay, client family
6470ff421860de64df4196f6891f11470625bce0.summary: CLI ad impression and click requests now include a unique client event ID and render delay metric. Server-side client family detection added via User-Agent parsing. Shared hygiene module introduced for consistent event handling.

7bdce0946bbc83e804efd99fca98fa2d99b90e19.title: Solar Pro 4 now supports limited access and unmetered full tier
7bdce0946bbc83e804efd99fca98fa2d99b90e19.summary: Solar Pro 4 moved to 'Full and limited access'. It is unmetered at full access. Limited access regions get it with session caps. New constants files added for desktop sessions and model entitlements.

10144f7ad1bd85fa528642276370444f1862214b.title: New shared dev-guest-auth constants file
10144f7ad1bd85fa528642276370444f1862214b.summary: Added `common/src/constants/dev-guest-auth.ts`. Defines `DEV_GUEST_PROVIDER` for local dev guest login. Isolated to avoid bundling server-only auth deps into client.

13c3ba7d0b36a754116bac24f76957a3eebb9f64.title: Add request_id to ads fetch log
13c3ba7d0b36a754116bac24f76957a3eebb9f64.summary: Added `request_id` to `ADS_FETCH_COMPLETED_FIELDS` in `axiom-only-log.ts` for request-grain correlation. Clarified `opportunity_id` remains auction-grain.

6222be5e6b2164b7dae9ff261d06be5fc88c2b47.title: Sponsored proposal UI drops cost disclosure
6222be5e6b2164b7dae9ff261d06be5fc88c2b47.summary: Removed text stating sponsored runs use user session and credits from `cli/src/components/blocks/sponsored-proposal-block.tsx`. Card now only mentions worktree.

4ac1fd1d59197d7f28602ac38da5d4c46e0277a3.title: Add Gemini 3.8 Flash to free model catalog
4ac1fd1d59197d7f28602ac38da5d4c46e0277a3.summary: Gemini 3.8 Flash is now available in the free model picker on Web, CLI, and Desktop. It supports 1M context and multimodal inputs (images, audio, video, PDFs). New agent definitions and reviewer configs were added to support the model.

219a700815b8cd4d3e19ae9761b2127a53a669e0.title: Add HMAC, Redis script caching, Axiom completeness guards
219a700815b8cd4d3e19ae9761b2127a53a669e0.summary: Added `hmac.ts`, `redis-cached-script.ts`, and `axiom-complete-response.ts` to centralize HMAC-SHA256 construction, implement `EVALSHA` with `EVAL` fallback for Redis Lua scripts, and enforce Axiom response completeness. Also added `chat_assistant_sr` house ad surface for server-rendered ad experiments.

7c5cc043fcad67cd82f362c61bc4c82cae553a78.title: New proportional intro pricing for Plus and Pro tiers
7c5cc043fcad67cd82f362c61bc4c82cae553a78.summary: First billing discounts are now proportional to tier cost instead of a flat $3. Plus intro price drops to $19 ($6 off) and Pro to $45 ($15 off). Note: these display values must match active Stripe coupons.

7faa16471f65d093f3535980864182ff79dac50a.title: Sponsored consent simplified to one sentence, two choices
7faa16471f65d093f3535980864182ff79dac50a.summary: Replaced multi-field consent list with single-sentence prompt matching desktop. Advertiser name clamped (80 chars), control/bidi chars escaped. Nameless consent now offers only 'No'.

18eee2a9d4ab53dcf63a34e2a5b113f86b86f469.title: Hide daily dollar ceiling from user meter
18eee2a9d4ab53dcf63a34e2a5b113f86b86f469.summary: Removed `spentUsd` from `FreebuffFreebucksSpendCeiling` type. Daily dollar limits are now strictly backend abuse backstops, not shown in UI to avoid confusion with Freebucks pool.

a852b83bdfb6dbc2fdc996eb33eecc2e1fbb2489.title: Add inclusion_reason, user_key_version fields to log schema
a852b83bdfb6dbc2fdc996eb33eecc2e1fbb2489.summary: Added `inclusion_probability_ppm`, `inclusion_reason`, and `user_key_version` fields to `ADS_FETCH_COMPLETED_FIELDS`. Deprecated `decision_outbox_sample_rate_ppm` as alias. Exported field names for testing.

38b9fb0ffb5f0f14035dcf78969d153d7b0acfd8.title: CLI: Accept sponsored proposals locally
38b9fb0ffb5f0f14035dcf78969d153d7b0acfd8.summary: Adds `/ads:accept-proposal` to run sponsored tasks in a local git worktree, gated by a consent screen. Introduces `/ads:pull-request` to push the resulting branch and `/ads:remove-worktree` to discard it.

ebb4deb34adc86dfaa1b4584d98edaf6db889f3d.title: SDK run() cancels promptly on abort during lookup or registration
ebb4deb34adc86dfaa1b4584d98edaf6db889f3d.summary: Added AbortSignal support to user lookup and agent-run registration. Aborts now cancel retries and backoff sleeps, returning 'Run cancelled by user' instead of hanging.

892f79590b0dbbf4753d4f66051c8b3d8af7a3ce.title: Add ad route refusal logging
892f79590b0dbbf4753d4f66051c8b3d8af7a3ce.summary: Introduced `ADS_REQUEST_REJECTED_EVENT` to log ad route refusals (rate limits, capability failures). Fields include `route`, `rail`, `reason`, `limiter_backend`, and `would_limit`.

6b1963707ad3659f9d2308535dff59f317cd8174.title: Added suppressCommitAttribution flag for agent commits
6b1963707ad3659f9d2308535dff59f317cd8174.summary: Introduced `suppressCommitAttribution` to AgentDefinition. Allows agents to omit `Co-Authored-By` and "Generated with" trailers from commit messages. Useful for sponsored proposals or runs committing to third-party repositories.

9b16ec41446c36cc56ac43f225aa3b720d29d848.title: Remove account deletion proof util
9b16ec41446c36cc56ac43f225aa3b720d29d848.summary: Deleted `common/src/util/account-deletion-proof.ts`. Internal refactor of HMAC proof logic.

7b65652ad9decd202054622a7fbe267cc7c11201.title: Add request geo tier and decision outbox logging fields
7b65652ad9decd202054622a7fbe267cc7c11201.summary: Added `request_geo_tier` to log viewer tier on all requests, distinct from policy-gated inventory tier. Added `decision_outbox_status` and `decision_outbox_sample_rate_ppm` to track decision-outbox producer outcomes and applied sampling rates.

c6a7eae9e05dad4f07be5d34298dcecf93ed08bd.title: Added observability fields for first-party ad experiments
c6a7eae9e05dad4f07be5d34298dcecf93ed08bd.summary: New fields in `ads.fetch_completed` log sticky user buckets, policy versions, and eligibility counts. These are observational only and do not affect routing logic yet.

8221e333895c0933b2ab58d669ac40272c339eb8.title: Freebucks daily pool, wallet, spend ceiling
8221e333895c0933b2ab58d669ac40272c339eb8.summary: Freebucks position now exposes daily pool, non-expiring wallet, and hard daily spend ceiling. Session admission reports freebucks shortfall.

26a3a70dac0329050970baa5e1d585b22c8ada9a.title: Update Privacy Policy Copy and Remove Expired Notice
26a3a70dac0329050970baa5e1d585b22c8ada9a.summary: Updated public data-use copy to reflect the September 2, 2026 privacy policy, specifically clarifying agent trace collection and restricted partner evaluations. Removed the expired July policy update notice metadata.

60123cbaaa09113e6f314b9c877df53e41165095.title: Add agenticAcceptEventId helper
60123cbaaa09113e6f314b9c877df53e41165095.summary: Introduces `agenticAcceptEventId` in `common/src/constants/agentic-ad-events.ts` to generate stable idempotency keys for funnel events.

f27429b2728f0614353df3194a77b493d0444e18.title: Fix Desktop sponsored conformance E-layer waivers
f27429b2728f0614353df3194a77b493d0444e18.summary: Added explicit waiver entries for Desktop E-3, E-4, E-5, and E-7 in `common/src/ads/sponsored-proposal-conformance.ts`. These rows are now marked as 'never run' because they rely on fake runners rather than real backend execution, ensuring accurate conformance reporting.

7f41c17658f1631e318a9aa7b0e4d9bd26ad58da.title: Fix sponsored run false OS error and path handling
7f41c17658f1631e318a9aa7b0e4d9bd26ad58da.summary: Added `no-consent-bridge` reason to distinguish missing desktop app from unsupported OS. Fixed tilde path expansion vulnerability and macOS sandbox device write permissions.

477a8a0d84c0b6cd3c5181ef0a6498eec2079321.title: Refactor session response types: isolate superseded state
477a8a0d84c0b6cd3c5181ef0a6498eec2079321.summary: Renamed `FreebuffSessionServerResponse` to `FreebuffSessionAdmissionResponse`. Moved `superseded` state into a separate `FreebuffSessionServerResponse` union with `desktopSessionCounts`. Internal type refactor.

9ede9a4a53b7798cd504493c12aa75323f7a0225.title: Clarify unit-test isolation from Infisical
9ede9a4a53b7798cd504493c12aa75323f7a0225.summary: Docs updated to explain why unit tests never load Infisical. Production rollout switches are mutable state, so importing them causes unrelated failures. Tests must set variables explicitly.

6edee52fa9c4ab5511163f99269dd8613f0669f2.title: Sponsored runs: capability-based tool grants
6edee52fa9c4ab5511163f99269dd8613f0669f2.summary: Sponsored runs now use a capability system to control tool access. Each tool is classified into a capability, and runs are granted specific capabilities. This applies to both cloud and local environments.

afc8351b5b724273614569816b30691f1fecf536.title: Removed deep research mode from web search tool
afc8351b5b724273614569816b30691f1fecf536.summary: Removed FutureSearch provider and `research` mode from `web_search` tool. Researcher agent now uses Serper API only. Deleted related constants and API client code.

4ff67e17e1d2980de3411ac0f573e20160b845d8.title: Fix sponsored run sandbox blocking git commits in linked worktrees
4ff67e17e1d2980de3411ac0f573e20160b845d8.summary: Added `sponsoredLinkedWorktreeGrants` to allow git operations in linked worktrees by granting minimal write access to specific `.git` subpaths. Prevents 'fatal: not a git repository' errors during sponsored PR creation.

56dbe402f41689aa095fa05026ddd53037ff462d.title: Added shared 24h TTL constant for sponsored run tokens
56dbe402f41689aa095fa05026ddd53037ff462d.summary: New file `common/src/ads/sponsored-run-token.ts` defines `SPONSORED_RUN_TOKEN_TTL_MS`. This constant ensures Next.js and Convex agree on the lifetime of off-Cloud sponsored run tokens.

2a6cd7375ba0be59db222123a7294c0982ad0453.title: Added listDisposableEmailDomains helper
2a6cd7375ba0be59db222123a7294c0982ad0453.summary: New function `listDisposableEmailDomains` added to `disposable-email.ts`. Returns read-only copy of curated disposable domains.

9b2ca33ed534768e4860d8b6949da3934abf2d81.title: Docs: Clarify house-ad suppression for subscribers
9b2ca33ed534768e4860d8b6949da3934abf2d81.summary: Updated `freebuff-house-ad.ts` documentation. Explicitly states that entitled subscribers are served no house ads via `resolveHouseSuppressedForUser`. Clarifies this is the only subscription-related check in serve paths; other ad logic unaffected.

26f3b123cc05ef5f25fd8b0fe2adf7fbbdeeb691.title: House ad frequency cap and rotation logic clarified
26f3b123cc05ef5f25fd8b0fe2adf7fbbdeeb691.summary: Updated `freebuff-house-ad.ts` comments to clarify that house ads are off by default and unset in production. Documented that the campaign now carries a shared per-user frequency cap, with rotation used for variety rather than avoiding a cap.

6a4ad1d04afdcc25bf6aea1e3503199ae65e39c3.title: Muse Spark 1.3 added; 1.2 retired; rate limit raised to 150 RPM
6a4ad1d04afdcc25bf6aea1e3503199ae65e39c3.summary: Meta Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor replaces 1.2 as the live model. 1.2 remains served to drain existing sessions but is hidden from pickers. Contributor rate limits increased to 150 RPM and 3M TPM.

dd1d934b7418b612d453d52e5fc2091011923dbc.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash default model, limited tier gains
dd1d934b7418b612d453d52e5fc2091011923dbc.summary: DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31 becomes default model everywhere, replacing GLM 5.3 Flash. Limited access users now get DeepSeek V4 Flash plus MiMo 2.5, with 6 daily sessions (up to 7 earnable). Saved preferences auto-migrate to new default.

3975224904d989f60ad8db9139bf51b7390e67c0.title: Add sponsored proposal controls in CLI chat
3975224904d989f60ad8db9139bf51b7390e67c0.summary: New interactive cards for sponsored proposals with dismiss/report/opt-out actions. Users can manage these via card menus or `/ads` slash commands. Keyboard focus is correctly scoped when proposal menus are open.

6891efd69b17644d4cc43382efd3a757e25507a1.title: Sticky first-party ad routing and expanded logging
6891efd69b17644d4cc43382efd3a757e25507a1.summary: Implemented sticky per-user first-party arm routing to stabilize experiment cohorts. Added extensive correlation and decision context fields to ad fetch logs, including opportunity IDs, policy versions, and geo pricing details.

59cca53dfb5bc9c9c03141f91494646de4a40ce3.title: Remove first-party arm sticky routing and ad fetch log fields
59cca53dfb5bc9c9c03141f91494646de4a40ce3.summary: Removed `FIRST_PARTY_ARM_SALT` and `firstPartyArmKey` from ad experiment utilities. Deleted extensive logging fields from `axiom-only-log.ts` including `opportunity_id`, `policy_version`, `first_party_arm_bucket`, and geo multiplier fields.

d227b0349fd05b02d6d5a0f0c628783996fbf89d.title: Add match_outcome field to conversion logs
d227b0349fd05b02d6d5a0f0c628783996fbf89d.summary: Added `match_outcome` to `ADS_EXTERNAL_CONVERSION_POSTBACK_FIELDS` in `axiom-only-log.ts`. Tracks email lookup results (`matched`, `unmatched`, etc.) for identity rails.

f2ddf900349a34acf802d7645accc70840d0a4f3.title: Web search tool adds agentic deep research mode
f2ddf900349a34acf802d7645accc70840d0a4f3.summary: The `web_search` tool now supports a `research: true` parameter to run multi-agent deep research, returning synthesized answers with citations instead of raw search results. This paid feature includes configurable effort tiers (`low`, `medium`, `high`), sub-question directions, and context passing to build on prior findings.

a90d9c446543900a2ec75675fe03844a537ac3f1.title: Per-model context compaction policies
a90d9c446543900a2ec75675fe03844a537ac3f1.summary: Added `compaction-policy.ts` to define model-specific context pruning rules. `base3` and `base2` agents now use dynamic idle gaps and token floors instead of hardcoded constants, with DeepSeek Flash receiving unique cache expiry settings.

c10a9f304bd1337ad48ef2b2294d38af5e460dab.title: Fix outdated '5-day' disclaimer text in subscription tier info
c10a9f304bd1337ad48ef2b2294d38af5e460dab.summary: Updated the rolling window disclaimer to dynamically reflect the current window length (now 7 days) instead of hardcoding '5-day'. This corrects a mismatch between the displayed text and the actual policy change made on 2026-08-31.

48b5fee79a1016800772e01eafa8ceb3db346f98.title: Limited session base 3→6. v0.0.166
48b5fee79a1016800772e01eafa8ceb3db346f98.summary: Freebuff v0.0.166 released. `FREEBUFF_LIMITED_SESSION_LIMIT` base restored 3→6. Levels 0-4 `freeSessionsPerDay` now 6. MiMo 2.5 access for limited-region users increased. Anti-abuse now relies solely on trust matrix.

8592ea01be0a05c20e0741bc3b1dfe82c4694e7b.title: Ignore scratch directory in git
8592ea01be0a05c20e0741bc3b1dfe82c4694e7b.summary: Added `scratch/` to `.gitignore` to prevent committing local resume state and sensitive approval capabilities from the intent-batch orchestrator.

e47bf5c35bbc5397a02ad2dc1074907ad4fdf225.title: Add house leg ad routing gate
e47bf5c35bbc5397a02ad2dc1074907ad4fdf225.summary: Added houseLegOpen() gate for own-promotion ads. New first_party_house_leg log field. Dark deploy, off by default.

2a958f98f5f8c683057d7419feae9093bea14cfb.title: Add statement descriptor suffix for Stripe charges
2a958f98f5f8c683057d7419feae9093bea14cfb.summary: Added `AD_STATEMENT_DESCRIPTOR_SUFFIX` constant to ensure card statements display 'FREEBUFF.COM' within Stripe's character limits. This clarifies billing descriptions for users.

a71de944590b9d02d5c182133e8c17de5e600db0.title: GLM v5.3 Flash: max reasoning restored, default set to max
a71de944590b9d02d5c182133e8c17de5e600db0.summary: Re-enabled `max` reasoning effort for GLM v5.3 Flash after measurements showed `high` and `xhigh` now provide minimal thinking. Updated default wire setting to `max` to ensure deep reasoning, accepting increased tool-call loop risk.

3b8fa14a1010363bb909958213fa8beea9c31a30.title: Add ad click attribution constants
3b8fa14a1010363bb909958213fa8beea9c31a30.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_AD_CLICK_ID_HEADER` and `FREEBUFF_AD_CLICK_ID_COOKIE` for server-to-server Stripe conversion tracking. Includes HMAC verification logic to prevent forged click IDs. Internal formatting updates applied.

01bf3cd467fb1a2700c866b3097fff745b3c0f5b.title: CLI model selector now displays free tier usage windows
01bf3cd467fb1a2700c866b3097fff745b3c0f5b.summary: The CLI model selector now shows daily, weekly, and monthly usage rings for free tier accounts, matching the layout used for subscribers. This display-only change helps free users track their allowance across multiple time windows.

5d679590800f31569758fe1002a5ef087668f7b7.title: Thinker agent switched to DeepSeek V4 Flash
5d679590800f31569758fe1002a5ef087668f7b7.summary: The `thinker-gemini` agent now uses DeepSeek V4 Flash instead of Gemini 3.1 Pro. Reasoning effort is set to high.

ae136bca432c7f3c74cb18d6c7fda924de2d8a12.title: Release v0.0.165
ae136bca432c7f3c74cb18d6c7fda924de2d8a12.summary: Version bump for `freebuff` CLI package to 0.0.165.

0d2d7a08594e7172e82d0f59a6a4c8a6bcc001b4.title: Solar Pro 4: lift 1/day cap, correct BYOK pricing
0d2d7a08594e7172e82d0f59a6a4c8a6bcc001b4.summary: Removed daily session cap for Solar Pro 4. OpenRouter BYOK cost estimates were 10x actual Upstage promo invoices. Users now access model via shared premium pool.

161b864dd4f665957ded8250837935b5f8612cfc.title: New shared sponsored-proposal view logic in common/src/ads
161b864dd4f665957ded8250837935b5f8612cfc.summary: Added `common/src/ads/sponsored-proposal-view.ts`. Defines surface-agnostic state machine, action sets, and safety gates (URL/logo token sanitization) for sponsored proposals, reusable by web and future terminal clients.

d36ecd09839c43b9c0949a8ad83ea5a171cba6bc.title: Added frequency logging fields
d36ecd09839c43b9c0949a8ad83ea5a171cba6bc.summary: Added `frequency_unavailable_causes` and `frequency_max_reservation_ms` to decision logging schema. Improves observability.

e1792f99509f9abc40904b9f4dad683d57510329.title: MRC50 viewability tracking, event schema
e1792f99509f9abc40904b9f4dad683d57510329.summary: New `imprezia-viewability.ts` implements MRC50 (50% pixels, 1s continuous) via state machine. `impreziaEventSchema` added to distinguish 'inserted' vs 'viewable' events.

7bcf9ba0b06d17819d238906d0d0436fa1eb432e.title: Add freebuffPlanHrs helper for abbreviated duration
7bcf9ba0b06d17819d238906d0d0436fa1eb432e.summary: Added `freebuffPlanHrs` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-subscriptions.ts` to generate abbreviated duration strings (e.g., "24 hrs") for UI secondary lines.

321907165f73f9a66f780f275f38e27092f87aa9.title: Add first-party ad preemption for Imprezia-first arm
321907165f73f9a66f780f275f38e27092f87aa9.summary: Implements `first_party_before_imprezia` routing for Tier-1 requests when Imprezia holds first refusal. Adds `impreziaArmPercent` config and `preempted` outcome logging.

70f1d8d632956affcf4ef483ae0c317dfd8d9403.title: GLM 5.3 Flash: default reasoning effort pinned to 'high', 'max' removed
70f1d8d632956affcf4ef483ae0c317dfd8d9403.summary: Removed 'max' from GLM 5.3 Flash user-facing reasoning ladder due to agent loop instability. Pinned wire default to 'high' to prevent excessive thinking depth on unset paths.

b6775f5c3e83b041816b59b2c2bb6dcadadf9f91.title: Ad preview widths 48/80/100. Floor 20 internal
b6775f5c3e83b041816b59b2c2bb6dcadadf9f91.summary: PLACEMENT_PREVIEW_WIDTHS changed 20/48/60 to 48/80/100. MIN_INLINE_AD_WIDTH=20 added as renderer floor. House-ad budget docs updated.

6341ef3af85281a213d98d6fab35e502e544dbd5.title: Add placementSurface helper to resolve ad surface
6341ef3af85281a213d98d6fab35e502e544dbd5.summary: Added `placementSurface` function in `freebuff-placements.ts` to determine the correct surface for a given placement ID. Includes handling for legacy CLI inline slots to ensure proper ad delivery and billing logic.

21d3b7668e7f43c2bcfbcd065b1915ae4329f6d3.title: Referral rewards now grant premium sessions instead of specific model
21d3b7668e7f43c2bcfbcd065b1915ae4329f6d3.summary: The CLI referral system changed from unlocking a specific model (GLM 5.2) to granting extra premium sessions. The model selector now displays all available models for a tier without filtering, while the referral banner updates to show session counts and resets. Full access users see a quiet line indicating earned sessions, while limited access users see the reward model unlock card.

12f8f2bb5b72969b7114cec9f24ae47e7e5e4500.title: Add shared token util. Fix double-count bug.
12f8f2bb5b72969b7114cec9f24ae47e7e5e4500.summary: New `common/src/util/tokens.ts` centralizes token math. Fixes account usage page double-counting cached prefix by treating `inputTokens` as already inclusive. Adds `formatTokens` for consistent K/M/B/T rendering.

091a224cd3b63af11dbded3dea62c726a669d112.title: Add terminal broker, tool overrides, file filter to CodebuffRunner
091a224cd3b63af11dbded3dea62c726a669d112.summary: CodebuffRunner now accepts `terminalCommandBroker`, `overrideTools`, and `collectDiff` options. A `fileFilter` blocks absolute paths and `..` traversal. Host-side git diff collection is gated by `collectDiff` (default true).

fcb16dec8af815505ae1dcc2d4f8be9c907fc814.title: Solar Pro 4: ZDR endpoint pin, daily/spend caps, experimental notice
fcb16dec8af815505ae1dcc2d4f8be9c907fc814.summary: Pinned Solar Pro 4 to `upstage/zdr` endpoint to fix cache splitting and ensure zero-data-retention. Added 1-session/day count cap and $0.50/session spend cap as measurement window. Updated model picker and refusal notices to label Solar Pro 4 as experimental.

d49020039fb91ec4c15dbfeaf70940853e84f5e8.title: Update referral banner link to account settings
d49020039fb91ec4c15dbfeaf70940853e84f5e8.summary: The 'Link GitHub' button in the CLI referral banner now opens `/account` instead of `/web/settings`.

210f7ac71cdb6b0f59662b85b4b86cdf0ef5e723.title: Lowered geo CPC floor to $0.10 for limited-tier clicks
210f7ac71cdb6b0f59662b85b4b86cdf0ef5e723.summary: Adjusted `AD_PLACEMENT_CPC_GEO_FLOOR_CENTS` from 50 to 10. Allows low-conversion country clicks to bill at a $0.10 minimum instead of $0.50, improving inventory monetization for limited-tier campaigns.

a49b46d62f39fd4cf45e3ba02499b8aefbca0d24.title: Restore Pro plan, new pricing, paywall UI
a49b46d62f39fd4cf45e3ba02499b8aefbca0d24.summary: Restored 'pro' subscription tier. Updated Starter/Plus limits and added free-tier allowance baseline. CLI landing screen now displays upgrade links when hitting spend ceilings. Adjusted elevated country spend limits ($5 to $1) with new paid floors.

f9b0815704eb34ebed2b8852b1a27c4902664d58.title: Add Freebucks session types and bump CLI to 0.0.163
f9b0815704eb34ebed2b8852b1a27c4902664d58.summary: Added `FreebuffFreebucksInfo` and `FreebuffFreebucksWindow` types to session responses. Included `getFreebucksInfo` helper for client access. Bumped release package version to 0.0.163.

28663a3cb73ad6b81408aa9cf131a8edf1f1f5ba.title: Add /export command; increase context compaction idle threshold to 1 hour
28663a3cb73ad6b81408aa9cf131a8edf1f1f5ba.summary: Added new `/export` CLI command to save full conversation to Markdown or JSON file, replacing previous `export` alias for `/copy`. Increased default idle threshold for context compaction from 30 minutes to 1 hour in `base3` agent and `agent-runtime`, reducing unnecessary history loss during short breaks.

dcc6b662d492759a0776826bd0ee32e36480baa4.title: Raise daily cap ceiling and fix slider resolution
dcc6b662d492759a0776826bd0ee32e36480baa4.summary: Increased maximum daily spend cap from $500 to $5000. Replaced linear slider with logarithmic ladder to make low-end budgets reachable while maintaining high-end precision.

f3e97864f5d12d3df41f0bc10e08b5afd66dd101.title: Unredact model pricing constants
f3e97864f5d12d3df41f0bc10e08b5afd66dd101.summary: Restored exact per-token pricing values in `freebuff-models.ts` and `free-agents.ts` previously marked `[redacted]`. Updated `freebuff-standing.ts`.

94eb1cfce38c1ccd0f91a5a7a1e66013863eabbb.title: Add geo-aware ad routing config, logic, and logging fields
94eb1cfce38c1ccd0f91a5a7a1e66013863eabbb.summary: Added `firstPartyAdRouteForGeoRequest` function and `FirstPartyGeoRoutingConfig` interface to support geo-tiered ad routing. New logging fields track geo routing state, inventory tier, country code, and tier2 bonus percentage. `DEFAULT_FIRST_PARTY_GEO_ROUTING` and `DEFAULT_FIRST_PARTY_TIER2_BONUS_PERCENT` constants added.

c3521fd87fc4c8f683e73c08251772dc976ca8ec.title: Add account deletion proof utility
c3521fd87fc4c8f683e73c08251772dc976ca8ec.summary: New file `common/src/util/account-deletion-proof.ts`. Implements HMAC-SHA256 proof generation and constant-time verification for account deletion flows.

d88c688727818ebcf7ce9bdcdcc18ba16d7946a2.title: Added CPC floor override validation and effective floor calculation
d88c688727818ebcf7ce9bdcdcc18ba16d7946a2.summary: Introduced `isValidPlacementCpcFloorOverride` to validate operator-set CPC floor exemptions. Added `effectivePlacementCpcFloorCents` to resolve the binding floor, ensuring invalid overrides fail safe to the global $1 minimum.

94288ad24bcefe362692ded7a3a8c692a503ff16.title: GLM 5.3 Flash removed from premium concurrency bucket
94288ad24bcefe362692ded7a3a8c692a503ff16.summary: GLM 5.3 Flash model ID removed from `FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_PREMIUM_BUCKET_MODEL_IDS`. This change reflects its unmetering and low production cost, allowing it to bypass the strict concurrency limits applied to premium models.

443f19f0eae03bcbc0dfb3ac6a5cd869fb9dcbae.title: Steer running agent mid-turn; skill input mode
443f19f0eae03bcbc0dfb3ac6a5cd869fb9dcbae.summary: Plain-text submissions now steer the active agent run at its next step boundary instead of waiting for the turn to end; falls back to the queue for attachments, slash commands, pending bash output, or when a queue already exists. Bare `/skill:<name>` drops into a skill input mode (banner names the pending skill) so instructions can be added before sending; empty submit runs the skill as-is. Prompt building for both entry paths is shared via `buildSkillPrompt`/`dispatchSkillPrompt`.

9c1de51074bf984f2827742fffce78a1e7580203.title: Ignore exported user lists
9c1de51074bf984f2827742fffce78a1e7580203.summary: Added `user-emails-*.csv` to `.gitignore` to prevent accidental commits of PII.

8542dfe658589b2433a7d039b031d1e0eab1be07.title: Advertiser credit line constants
8542dfe658589b2433a7d039b031d1e0eab1be07.summary: Added constants for advertiser trust score and derived credit line limits. Includes windows, caps, and per-run move limits.

77a74b9437db605159cf13c57b72d52293a6f17b.title: CLI release 1.0.686 published
77a74b9437db605159cf13c57b72d52293a6f17b.summary: Version bump for `codebuff` (1.0.685 -> 1.0.686) and `freebuff` (0.0.161 -> 0.0.162). No functional code changes included in this diff.

a67e89052816db2de4de5bc42c4b6c318f91797a.title: Subscribers get higher Freebuff Desktop session limits
a67e89052816db2de4de5bc42c4b6c318f91797a.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_SUBSCRIBER_DESKTOP_SESSION_LIMITS` (premium: 3, unlimited: 8) and `freebuffDesktopSessionLimits` helper. Paid plans now bypass the limited-tier single-tab rule, allowing multiple premium model sessions concurrently.

23c05c4a5fce1db9301b66529c2dd543d51c1e77.title: Add deliverySpendCents to PlacementTotals interface
23c05c4a5fce1db9301b66529c2dd543d51c1e77.summary: Introduced `deliverySpendCents` field in `PlacementTotals` to separate raw delivery costs from ledger-based billing. Updated `spendCents` documentation to clarify ledger inclusion and creative grain behavior.

477b0e47facf165557cca9b60a070dacc3f6f9d9.title: Fix Freebuff model selection for limited access
477b0e47facf165557cca9b60a070dacc3f6f9d9.summary: CLI now preserves explicit model picks for paid users with limited access instead of forcing fallback. Selection state reconciles correctly on session updates.

e5d41741aeca4ae11989042f2af1647b94c11e41.title: GLM 5.3 Flash gains reasoning effort control
e5d41741aeca4ae11989042f2af1647b94c11e41.summary: Users can now select `low`, `high`, or `max` reasoning effort for GLM 5.3 Flash. Default set to `max` to preserve previous deep reasoning behavior while allowing faster `low` option.

fd3c20c290bf78152ecc86ab7ba9191f420ca1ea.title: GLM 5.3 Flash new default model, unmetered
fd3c20c290bf78152ecc86ab7ba9191f420ca1ea.summary: GLM 5.3 Flash replaces GPT-5.6 Luna as the default model in full mode. It is now unmetered (no session cost) and leads the catalog, with reasoning effort defaults adjusted to provider-native settings.

bd4a417e32556ffb2004437274d0cdd893ad3907.title: Agentic Ad Events Vocabulary Added
bd4a417e32556ffb2004437274d0cdd893ad3907.summary: New file defines event types for sponsored proposal funnel. Includes billing rule: only 'accepted' bills as CPC click. Internal telemetry and advertiser postback events separated.

72fffec8570aebd6a07ae1fce403fcdedee01dbd.title: GLM 5.3 Flash unmetered
72fffec8570aebd6a07ae1fce403fcdedee01dbd.summary: GLM 5.3 Flash moved from premium to unmetered pool. Cheapest row, cost analysis justified removing cap. Tier notice updated.

4a9013b2a97bd2bade3e61b99f3deb7814094eb0.title: Add 'channel' field to ADS conversion postback telemetry
4a9013b2a97bd2bade3e61b99f3deb7814094eb0.summary: Updated `ADS_EXTERNAL_CONVERSION_POSTBACK_FIELDS` in `axiom-only-log.ts` to include a `channel` string field. This distinguishes between 's2s' (key-authenticated) and 'client' (keyless browser) ingress sources for operational telemetry.

6ace1d00c9409518218bbf90225391e9002a5b21.title: Add delivery spacing to prevent bursty ad campaigns
6ace1d00c9409518218bbf90225391e9002a5b21.summary: New `deliverySpacingSeconds` helper calculates a minimum gap between ad deliveries. This smooths out engagement flow within a time window, preventing the 'pulse' effect where a batch of ads is delivered all at once followed by a long pause.

df7e3aa400c51c34ba5185d01ce1527c892a671f.title: CLI usage banners now use long-form reset time display
df7e3aa400c51c34ba5185d01ce1527c892a671f.summary: The `subscription-limit-banner` and `usage-banner` components have been updated to use `formatResetTimeLong` instead of `formatResetTime` for displaying reset countdowns. The `formatResetTime` utility function was removed from `cli/src/utils/time-format.ts` as it was just an alias.

f4fca07fcd3d2a041699d3c1216bb216d2dae2ec.title: Document geo-adjusted CPC floor constant
f4fca07fcd3d2a041699d3c1216bb216d2dae2ec.summary: Added `AD_PLACEMENT_CPC_GEO_FLOOR_CENTS` constant with detailed documentation. Clarifies distinction between campaign-level and click-level pricing floors.

1312fa1702921f9df8394bf191da9ef062fba043.title: Export house ad favicon URL constant
1312fa1702921f9df8394bf191da9ef062fba043.summary: The house ad favicon URL is now exported as `HOUSE_AD_FAVICON_URL` to support campaigns that cannot upload a logo via the standard creative image mechanism.

179f317de8d228cc02d32ac4730781a8c0aadbc9.title: v0.0.160 release
179f317de8d228cc02d32ac4730781a8c0aadbc9.summary: Version bumped to 0.0.160 in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json`. No other user-visible changes.

590e6d257bf4128557f1e5823077c586bb424138.title: Ad pacing: daily fraction to rolling 60m window
590e6d257bf4128557f1e5823077c586bb424138.summary: Changed pacing logic for tapering campaigns from a cumulative daily fraction to a strict 60-minute rolling window limit. This prevents burst delivery at midnight or after quiet periods. Added avalanche finalizer to hash function to fix low-bit bias in jitter calculations.

1f35b8067456bba14e902e3018e6c41545b2a64e.title: Add Imprezia fetch telemetry event with strict sanitization
1f35b8067456bba14e902e3018e6c41545b2a64e.summary: New internal `ads.imprezia_fetch_completed` event added to Axiom-only logging. Includes allowlisted fields and validation for outcomes, surfaces, and failure classes. Ensures no raw identifiers or provider errors are logged.

5c0c933cea38831e8f3c2a1042c1852363445159.title: Add exponential budget glide and daily pacing
5c0c933cea38831e8f3c2a1042c1852363445159.summary: Budget glide now supports exponential decay for faster initial drop-off. New `pacedDailyAllowance` function spreads campaign delivery evenly across the day instead of exhausting the cap early.

8f390e940d2f9457ea52bca4567f727f0a049277.title: Fix leaked reasoning tags rendering as plain text
8f390e940d2f9457ea52bca4567f727f0a049277.summary: Added logic to detect and split think tags from content streams. Reasoning that leaks into visible text is now routed to the thinking box or stripped, preventing raw tags from appearing in responses.

cb3ef3135c27c68f08c1c3e92290607a08732afc.title: GLM 5.3 Flash cap removed, Merge Gateway added
cb3ef3135c27c68f08c1c3e92290607a08732afc.summary: GLM 5.3 Flash no longer has a 2-session/day cap; it now uses the shared premium allowance. Merge Gateway added as a spend provider for this model.

42989afa85b9d0c2cf43c220309ef9f05951d3bb.title: DeepSeek Flash availability restored; peak-hours restrictions removed
42989afa85b9d0c2cf43c220309ef9f05951d3bb.summary: DeepSeek Flash availability changed from `off_peak_only` to `always`, reopening the model after a four-day closure that caused excess costs on Luna. Peak-hours restrictions and related subscription disclaimers removed from Freebuff tiers.

3623ca3ffeb9e8ed71a65207075c1d4d18e639f3.title: Fix misleading ad copy
3623ca3ffeb9e8ed71a65207075c1d4d18e639f3.summary: Updated house ads to reflect actual subscription benefits (sessions added, not replaced). Removed false claims about skipping queues or ads.

73b3e16cdc03da2402d2a3eed7e3bbec76b073f1.title: New /reasoning command for CLI
73b3e16cdc03da2402d2a3eed7e3bbec76b073f1.summary: Added `/reasoning` slash command to set model thinking effort (low/high/max) for next message. Model selector now displays active reasoning level.

d40c36e4aae67b74e3067d4c23a2c1c3db9bf665.title: Ignore agent worktrees
d40c36e4aae67b74e3067d4c23a2c1c3db9bf665.summary: Added `.claude/worktrees/` to `.gitignore` to prevent agent tooling from committing duplicate migration indices.

2f4829e864d268f1cd6987537fd7956f6c67d0dc.title: Add Freebuff subscription house ad copy
2f4829e864d268f1cd6987537fd7956f6c67d0dc.summary: New file `common/src/constants/freebuff-house-ad.ts` defines marketing copy for the subscription fallback ad. It covers surfaces like `cli_chat`, `waiting_room`, and `freebuff_web_chat`, pulling the entry price dynamically from `FREEBUFF_SUBSCRIPTION_TIERS`.

02f42768b0bc73acb01625d4d082a2f6f72d497e.title: CLI: Limited-tier paid subscribers see plan models
02f42768b0bc73acb01625d4d082a2f6f72d497e.summary: The CLI model selector now detects active paid subscriptions. Limited-tier users with a plan see their purchased models in the picker instead of only free options. This aligns the client UI with server-side admission rules.

57c010db236b4b5ffba7030cb4eff4bb50a4a333.title: CLI model picker shows plan summary
57c010db236b4b5ffba7030cb4eff4bb50a4a333.summary: CLI model selector now displays paid plan windows (today, 5-day, month) and blocking limits. Shared summary logic added for consistent display across CLI, Desktop, and web.

7bb5501109a4dd88daf5e262cb1356b7b815b200.title: Fix levelProgress return value to use clamped trust
7bb5501109a4dd88daf5e262cb1356b7b815b200.summary: `levelProgress` in `freebuff-levels.ts` now returns `trust: clamped` instead of raw `trust`. Prevents unclamped values leaking into progress calculations.

f68e7ca5489c3652786a98440b44dc36b95d9176.title: Add Budget Glide logic for campaign delivery caps
f68e7ca5489c3652786a98440b44dc36b95d9176.summary: Introduced `BudgetGlide` interface and helper functions (`glidedDailyBudgetCents`, `effectiveDailyBudgetCents`) to calculate randomized, linear daily budget caps for free campaigns. This prevents predictable supply gaps and ensures paying campaigns are never silently tapered.

a4837a425cd7f9ac57d590d53a9ef1bc20fa63f6.title: SDK: ripgrep 15.2.0 + Windows arm64 support
a4837a425cd7f9ac57d590d53a9ef1bc20fa63f6.summary: Bundled ripgrep updated to 15.2.0. Added native binary support for Windows on ARM64.

9188c032117f7f2326e7bec8afb0a1bc62c33c1a.title: Ad routing now uses request sampling
9188c032117f7f2326e7bec8afb0a1bc62c33c1a.summary: First-party ad routing now applies percentages per request using server-minted `sampleId` instead of persistent user cohorts. Fallback to `userId` ensures backward compatibility for legacy callers.

2cf1163dc72fd40df1b7d56a4ed94d668116dc47.title: Fix Imprezia ad fetch timeout handling
2cf1163dc72fd40df1b7d56a4ed94d668116dc47.summary: Moved response body consumption inside try block to ensure timeout and abort signals remain active until JSON is parsed. Prevents indefinite hangs on stalled Imprezia ad responses.

38feaebb146a689d5dbf3a38b322e7db2e63f071.title: Add yield experiment config and Imprezia outcome telemetry
38feaebb146a689d5dbf3a38b322e7db2e63f071.summary: New `yield-experiment.ts` defines CPC yield arms and validation. `imprezia-client.ts` adds `AbortSignal` support and outcome observers. `axiom-only-log.ts` extends schema with yield shadow/live fields.

9501bb0a55ec3bbbd225e477130c427534dc3f11.title: Added Solar Pro 4 to free model picker
9501bb0a55ec3bbbd225e477130c427534dc3f11.summary: Solar Pro 4 is now available in the free model catalog as a limited-time trial. It offers 524K context and text-only support.

ec3142a4e62ca638acd914b68a3842d4e8c347f3.title: Fix stale run state on chat switch and abort
ec3142a4e62ca638acd914b68a3842d4e8c347f3.summary: Prevents previousRunStateRef from leaking into new chats when aborting or switching conversations. Adds `getClient` dependency injection seam for testing.

f7d35db5a5e064e98c9f12739e68f1583ced9c5d.title: Clarify GLM 5.3 Flash quota: 2 starts/day, not sessions
f7d35db5a5e064e98c9f12739e68f1583ced9c5d.summary: Updated CLI quota display and user-facing notices to distinguish between 'starts' (admissions) and fractional 'session units'. GLM 5.3 Flash limit is now explicitly stated as 2 starts per day. Added `countsAdmissions` flag to session rate limit types to support this distinction.

0591414315966ad5f2442f39de7c0ca6a9478558.title: Lower default postpaid credit line
0591414315966ad5f2442f39de7c0ca6a9478558.summary: Default max unpaid placement spend reduced from $250 to $100.

4ff202b7d262eb975b755a5da73965c661801cc6.title: Clarify plan limits, add upgrade hints
4ff202b7d262eb975b755a5da73965c661801cc6.summary: Plan copy now specifies "hours" instead of ambiguous session counts and uses "tokens" for spend limits. Server responses for rate/spend limits include structured upgrade hints with URLs and messages.

adbcb4e4a515334bd3f46580fe8188ba3d27bf84.title: Referral promo: $100 spent, $500 reward
adbcb4e4a515334bd3f46580fe8188ba3d27bf84.summary: Referral launch promotion updated. Qualification now requires $100 collected and spent on active reviewed campaign. Both sides receive $500 credit.

6f7cf660e827d750b278497432eebfa763ca58e5.title: Add Imprezia display ad support
6f7cf660e827d750b278497432eebfa763ca58e5.summary: New `fetchImpreziaDisplayAd` allows filling display slots without a chat context. Shared transport logic refactored into `postToImprezia` and `refusesSandboxKey`. New `imprezia-display.ts` file added.

5c250334a319ef47c7ae2d5653ec7f062e1eead1.title: Add launch promo constants and ledger reasons
5c250334a319ef47c7ae2d5653ec7f062e1eead1.summary: Adds constants for a launch promotion matching first $500 of placements spend and referrer rewards. Introduces new ledger reasons 'promo_credit' and 'promo_reversal' with updated statement kind and credit logic.

47c4bf8cf7f311a30adfb47f4ca09d914cc3ce9a.title: Ad placements postpaid credit, collection ledger reasons, CPC floors
47c4bf8cf7f311a30adfb47f4ca09d914cc3ce9a.summary: Added AD_POSTPAID_DEFAULT_CREDIT_LINE_CENTS (25000) and AD_PLACEMENT_COLLECTION_RETENTION_DAYS (180) constants. New ledger reasons 'collection', 'collection_refund', 'collection_chargeback' added to AD_SPEND_LEDGER_REASONS. statementKindForReason maps 'collection' to 'payment'; isCreditReason now includes 'collection'. CPC floor (100 cents) and reprice limits (25% max move, 50 min clicks) defined.

b3e1d17c5a89e05ad7692f0dd70466a97851a3c7.title: Add exception budget to PostHog analytics
b3e1d17c5a89e05ad7692f0dd70466a97851a3c7.summary: New `exception-budget.ts` limits repeated exceptions sent to PostHog. `createPostHogClient` now uses a `before_send` hook to collapse identical errors into geometric occurrences (1, 10, 100...), preventing billing spikes from retry loops.

9066513a775a950c3c5f620141e41cd8ebfc76b3.title: Add constant for Desktop idle session release
9066513a775a950c3c5f620141e41cd8ebfc76b3.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_IDLE_RELEASE_MS` constant set to 10 minutes. This defines the timeout for releasing a Desktop tab's session when idle.

e30c58d37ea03426da0f01a727c5acff3895a462.title: Fix withdrawn model admission: prevent silent fallback and resource waste
e30c58d37ea03426da0f01a727c5acff3895a462.summary: Withdrawn models now refuse admission with explicit system messages. Prevents users from unknowingly falling back to different models or wasting session units on unavailable picks.

bd5c18ff73257a748a3bd0e402e25af4c012649f.title: Paid plans unlock premium models in limited regions
bd5c18ff73257a748a3bd0e402e25af4c012649f.summary: Subscribers in limited regions can now access premium models. Starter and Plus plan session limits were reduced to better match compute costs.

c359f63c20bbc0f7d23fb950af7764257b6ec274.title: Fix timezone ambiguity in model availability messages
c359f63c20bbc0f7d23fb950af7764257b6ec274.summary: All model unavailability labels now explicitly name the timezone (e.g. "10:00 AM UTC") to prevent misinterpretation. Server responses include an `availableAt` ISO timestamp, allowing clients to render accurate local times. Added shared formatting utilities to ensure consistent timezone labeling across CLI, Desktop, and Web.

cb53f476e75fa8151b31fc9ae263d0aa59281d5d.title: Add cancellation reason validation and beta rate lock constant
cb53f476e75fa8151b31fc9ae263d0aa59281d5d.summary: Introduced `FREEBUFF_CANCELLATION_REASONS` with strict ID validation to standardize offboarding data. Added `FREEBUFF_BETA_RATE_LOCK_MULTIPLIER` constant to define beta pricing terms.

8d7a935e56beac4db2faa5f2421e2af0f1c6a905.title: Ox Alpha withdrawn from free model catalog
8d7a935e56beac4db2faa5f2421e2af0f1c6a905.summary: Ox Alpha removed from free model picker. Host ended free promotion. Model ID paused for backward compatibility with existing CLI/Desktop binaries.

68b487b1f0fc0e9fd42f83503efa2533890ff411.title: GLM 5.3 Flash replaces DeepSeek V4 Pro in free model picker
68b487b1f0fc0e9fd42f83503efa2533890ff411.summary: DeepSeek V4 Pro retired from catalog. GLM 5.3 Flash added as deep-reasoning model, capped at 2 sessions daily. New agent definitions for orchestrator and code reviewer added.

9043277365c41dd3d8c20f4d192b64d879823dce.title: Feed requires original comments; adds default guidance
9043277365c41dd3d8c20f4d192b64d879823dce.summary: Replaced generated comment suggestions with explicit writing rules requiring original, human-written text. Added default comment guidance for advertisers to ensure clear expectations.

28d0514641dc8804ec29db0727c13bb9f2bc2ca1.title: Docs: subscription adds to free pool, quota-exempt report free
28d0514641dc8804ec29db0727c13bb9f2bc2ca1.summary: Updated `FreebuffSessionEntitlementBreakdown` docs: `subscription` is now an addition to `base`, not a replacement. `FreebuffSubscriptionUsage` free fields now reported for quota-exempt accounts (god/admin).

b11ec75a04ede2ef903e89bbe41fb5080514e102.title: Add free premium session usage fields
b11ec75a04ede2ef903e89bbe41fb5080514e102.summary: Added `freeDayUsed` and `freeDayLimit` to `FreebuffSubscriptionUsage`. These optional fields expose the caller's daily free premium-session pool, preventing clients from double-counting plan limits when the free pool is exhausted.

1d9a61e734810b53404ced16489971b33109725e.title: Gate DeepSeek V4 Pro on Web with peak-hour closures
1d9a61e734810b53404ced16489971b33109725e.summary: Added DeepSeek V4 Pro to subscription-gated model list, enforced exclusively on Freebuff Web. Web clients now see the model closed during DeepSeek peak hours (double cost) and open during off-peak windows, while Desktop and CLI retain free access. Legacy clients remain unaffected.

10218ba5aa9794a3327524cc1922daa9f3e39ce1.title: Add model availability window labels and pro-only gating
10218ba5aa9794a3327524cc1922daa9f3e39ce1.summary: New labels show when time-gated models are open in the user's local timezone, aiding planning. Added infrastructure for pro-only model restrictions and plan pause windows, currently empty.

9f0de8454bcac2ea8898d1f6592c488da4942f7b.title: Hide Imprezia ad destination URL
9f0de8454bcac2ea8898d1f6592c488da4942f7b.summary: Set `url` field to empty string in `impreziaImpressionFields`. Prevents rendering opaque token as advertiser domain.

b42492330322ad9c82caf4620c05e4ab36d661d4.title: docs: Linux CI uses cold Bun installs, skips dep cache
b42492330322ad9c82caf4620c05e4ab36d661d4.summary: Updated `docs/testing.md` to document that `node_modules` caching is disabled on Linux CI jobs. Cold `bun install` proved faster and cheaper than warm cache restores on Ubicloud runners. Windows and macOS caching remains unchanged pending further measurements.

907cda721501e4f656b82ef0bf61e19af07926ef.title: Preserve subscription data during session transitions
907cda721501e4f656b82ef0bf61e19af07926ef.summary: Added logic to carry `subscription` info across session states and compact polls. This prevents the plan panel from disappearing or blinking during picker interactions and session updates.

72f1310353bddeacfee88d760a6193527ff69dd2.title: Luna/Pro sub-cap lifted on Starter/Pro tiers
72f1310353bddeacfee88d760a6193527ff69dd2.summary: Removed daily premium session caps for Starter and Pro tiers. UI disclaimers now hide cap text when limits match daily totals.

15ebdcb20344b1faa17ff5345846ba1241d3e664.title: Fix stray closing think tag handling
15ebdcb20344b1faa17ff5345846ba1241d3e664.summary: Fixed parser to treat stray `</think>` as thinking content instead of plain text. Internal refactor of block append logic.

ec01bf10020d29d13062f0218f3176e5a0e3f4b0.title: Add daily/total budget spent reasons
ec01bf10020d29d13062f0218f3176e5a0e3f4b0.summary: Added `daily_cap_spent` and `total_budget_spent` to `NOT_SERVING_REASONS` and `NOT_SERVING_COPY`. These constants align with serve path refusal states to prevent console/auction status disparity.

7a65d914646cc0f2883efcbc94971198e8064c16.title: Fix model-unavailable window message
7a65d914646cc0f2883efcbc94971198e8064c16.summary: Corrected error message when models are unavailable. Now shows accurate return time for DeepSeek peak windows instead of generic staffing hours.

4a41787b377f56263a296bc5a8458ad2707aafae.title: First-party ad provider, resilient view ack, placement ordering
