4a41787b377f56263a296bc5a8458ad2707aafae.summary: Adds `first_party` ad provider with resilient view acknowledgement. CLI ads now use placement IDs for ordering and display. New common modules for first-party view ack and waiting room placements.

c5e4bf5459e0119e774dbda81d74d89d580f6c6f.title: Tier change notice: per-model caps removed
c5e4bf5459e0119e774dbda81d74d89d580f6c6f.summary: Updated `FREEBUFF_TIER_CHANGE_NOTICE` to remove temporary V4 Pro fallback text and announce removal of per-model caps, noting MiMo and DeepSeek V4 Flash stay unmetered.

4e45c27aa823ee8d4a0abe9d493d85479e030149.title: Add FusionCode provider; update tier notice
4e45c27aa823ee8d4a0abe9d493d85479e030149.summary: Added 'fusioncode' to spend provider IDs. Updated Freebuff tier change notice to reflect V4 Pro temporarily using V4 Flash.

cb3ea78eda6ea14b43bc1624d0e854fdd9a898d0.title: GitHub ads, one-post campaigns, LinkedIn shortener
cb3ea78eda6ea14b43bc1624d0e854fdd9a898d0.summary: Added GitHub as an ad platform using star-based engagement with specific validation and attestation. Campaigns now limited to one post per campaign, and the 7-day max length cap removed in favor of open-ended subscriptions. LinkedIn URL validation now accepts `lnkd.in` shortener.

54790e3a6614fea67d6dabd01fd367fabb684dc8.title: SDK: Add privacy-safe repo snapshot to trace metadata
54790e3a6614fea67d6dabd01fd367fabb684dc8.summary: SDK run now includes aggregate repository metrics in chat completion traces. New allowlist in `common/util/file.ts` filters sensitive fields like diffs and file paths before export. Trace contract updated with `repo_snapshot` and `surface` columns.

fbda78872046ff7f2223c83c8093d1d1f9237dca.title: Add ads-pilot-launch.local.json to .gitignore
fbda78872046ff7f2223c83c8093d1d1f9237dca.summary: Updated .gitignore to exclude local operator launch manifests containing real advertiser identifiers, preventing accidental commits of sensitive data.

81dc44a30b2de783596bce9e6c8192a674be6a23.title: Add billing mode fields to axiom-only-log
81dc44a30b2de783596bce9e6c8192a674be6a23.summary: Added `first_party_billing_mode` and `external_settlement_enabled` to `ADS_FETCH_COMPLETED_FIELDS` in `axiom-only-log.ts`. These fields log effective runtime money gates as bounded configuration state.

a733b317c1e05ace5fe868e3d4f52d300dbd018c.title: Restore daily cap on GLM 5.2 sessions
a733b317c1e05ace5fe868e3d4f52d300dbd018c.summary: GLM 5.2 referral sessions now capped at 1 per day. Banner hides "invite for +1/day" once cap reached.

dc2947f208c695a64f1781053d8afe1a3968a40a.title: Mid-stream provider errors now show real reason
dc2947f208c695a64f1781053d8afe1a3968a40a.summary: OpenAI-compatible streaming error chunks now surface upstream detail (e.g. OpenRouter refusals) instead of generic wording. Errors render as `message [provider: raw]` matching non-stream failures.

ed41bbe6cce57a22a3d03f3a69848063615c385c.title: Clarify Imprezia client platformString documentation
ed41bbe6cce57a22a3d03f3a69848063615c385c.summary: Updated JSDoc for `platformString` in `ImpreziaChatAdRequest` to define it as the platform family, separating it from product attribution in `surface`.

ed27ce1cf3e461105e209dcd13d8e5e22219331f.title: Add ADS_EXTERNAL_CONVERSION_POSTBACK_EVENT to Axiom logging
ed27ce1cf3e461105e209dcd13d8e5e22219331f.summary: Introduced `ADS_EXTERNAL_CONVERSION_POSTBACK_EVENT` and associated field schema for advertiser S2S conversion postbacks. Ensures only bounded operational dimensions are logged, excluding partner credentials and opaque identifiers.

99c8777e213d27579525e378d569d3e430d7b1e6.title: Deduplicate Imprezia sandbox refusal logs
99c8777e213d27579525e378d569d3e430d7b1e6.summary: Refusal to serve ads with sandbox keys now logs `error` once per process, then `debug`. Prevents log flooding and Axiom billing spikes from misconfigured environments.

8238d829cad6ce2b95694de923e6e58c9a240e5d.title: Flat $3 intro + monthly spend cap
8238d829cad6ce2b95694de923e6e58c9a240e5d.summary: First-month price now $3 off every tier. Added `monthlySpendLimitUsd` to cap provider costs; plan sessions pause if reached, free sessions continue.

a4d50e7363432ab28c574b022a0b2fc76de0ab2a.title: Add ads click and impression tracking events
a4d50e7363432ab28c574b022a0b2fc76de0ab2a.summary: Added `ads.first_party_click_recorded` and `ads.first_party_impression_recorded` events with allowlisted fields (provider, surface, placement_id, already_clicked, impression_recorded, pixel_count).

8d2fe1d276001824281f633df332852e67e82564.title: Block 5 spam email domains
8d2fe1d276001824281f633df332852e67e82564.summary: Added five disposable email domains to blocklist based on honeypot probing metrics. Improves spam account prevention.

8bf398cd72689f7ca4bea6eb14ad7a7b162763ee.title: v0.0.155: DeepSeek V4 Flash unlimited again for full-access
8bf398cd72689f7ca4bea6eb14ad7a7b162763ee.summary: DeepSeek V4 Flash is removed from the premium pool and returns to unmetered status for full-access users, now running on the cheaper Luminal lane. The tier change notice updated to reflect both MiMo and Flash as unmetered. Limited tier access remains unchanged.

116f691de944ce3ef91a7e628964eba0b4e6c10d.title: Remove per-model daily session caps; unify under normal daily limit
116f691de944ce3ef91a7e628964eba0b4e6c10d.summary: Per-model daily caps are gone. All models now draw on your normal daily sessions. MiMo 2.5 and Ox Alpha stay unmetered and cost no session at all.

8953a389fa9deb1c8cb479d483b24327a2c38cb7.title: Add tracked link placement labels and first-party routing normalization
8953a389fa9deb1c8cb479d483b24327a2c38cb7.summary: Added `placementSlotLabel` to handle 'tracked-link' placement IDs in reporting. Refactored `firstPartyPrimaryBasisPoints` to normalize percentage configs to basis points, ensuring consistent routing logic. Extended Axiom logging fields to include first-party cohort details and allocation validity flags.

836022e5e8a479b8330a80261070e80b636da639.title: Desktop premium concurrency bucket decoupled from quota list
836022e5e8a479b8330a80261070e80b636da639.summary: Split the desktop premium concurrency bucket from the premium quota list in `freebuff-models.ts`. Concurrency membership is now explicit rather than derived, preventing quota changes from silently capping concurrent tabs.

0b60b7df7979a111f67629386bd2a64f36885060.title: Replace raw git diff with structured repository summary
0b60b7df7979a111f67629386bd2a64f36885060.summary: The agent system prompt now receives a concise repository summary (branch, visibility, contributor stats, test file detection) instead of raw `git diff` and `status` output. This reduces token usage and provides clearer context for code navigation.

115a6a5cc676b1a4969d2045ad34ebb5d8bd00ab.title: Onboarding accepts partial submissions
115a6a5cc676b1a4969d2045ad34ebb5d8bd00ab.summary: Users can now submit onboarding questionnaires with some questions skipped. Previously, partial answers were rejected with a 400 error. Only entirely empty submissions are refused.

989208414f3649ca01ab3b87500917770ddcf204.title: Add gravity_outcome log field
989208414f3649ca01ab3b87500917770ddcf204.summary: Added `gravity_outcome` to `ADS_FETCH_COMPLETED_FIELDS` in `axiom-only-log.ts`. Enables tracking of Gravity attempt status (filled/no-filled/failed) without logging campaign identity.

f8ed82aaaa4ed3c5776a04b6c7423b894b294f74.title: Add Ox Alpha to free model picker
f8ed82aaaa4ed3c5776a04b6c7423b894b294f74.summary: Added Ox Alpha to the free model catalog with full and limited access. It features a 1M context window and no session cost, but is marked experimental with a 'TEST' badge in the CLI.

e3a285c926ba174296495a785ca36ed7ea44aad8.title: Improve useEvent hook type safety
e3a285c926ba174296495a785ca36ed7ea44aad8.summary: Refactored `useEvent` hook in `cli/src/hooks/use-event.ts` to use generic parameters `TArgs` and `TReturn` instead of `any`. This removes the need for type casting and improves internal type safety.

467ba64dca85ea541f5c3db0d34bbf024ccccf92.title: Add surface field to Imprezia chat ad request
467ba64dca85ea541f5c3db0d34bbf024ccccf92.summary: Added a `surface` field to `ImpreziaChatAdRequest` in `common/src/util/imprezia-client.ts`. This field accepts values like 'desktop', 'cli', 'cloud', 'web', 'chat', or 'mobile' to identify the calling surface.

01b15151126e71919675bb0ab8972e1720377b12.title: Default model switched to GPT-5.6 Luna; DeepSeek V4 Flash off-peak only
01b15151126e71919675bb0ab8972e1720377b12.summary: DeepSeek V4 Flash availability changed to `off_peak_only` due to peak cost spikes, with fallback to GPT-5.6 Luna. GPT-5.6 Luna is now the default model for new CLI/Web users to ensure 24/7 availability.

061b2465fb339069a9a7b09081c6125a5919a574.title: GPT-5.6 Luna default, DeepSeek peak pause, downgrade fields
061b2465fb339069a9a7b09081c6125a5919a574.summary: GPT-5.6 Luna replaces DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31 as full-mode default. DeepSeek models now pause during peak hours. Subscription types add `downgrade` flag and `pendingTierId` for scheduled tier changes.

7e9bd8cdb6cb73fb329d494669361e7226a17ed0.title: Ad creative sanitizer blocks invisible Unicode evasion
7e9bd8cdb6cb73fb329d494669361e7226a17ed0.summary: Expanded `sanitizeAdText` in `ad-creative-safety.ts` to strip full Unicode Default_Ignorable_Code_Point set. Prevents invisible characters from bypassing prohibited word checks.

d9e94b083c24c9e1fa9655b0e55f5cdfc6506865.title: Remove GPT-5.6 Luna session cap
d9e94b083c24c9e1fa9655b0e55f5cdfc6506865.summary: GPT-5.6 Luna is now uncapped and uses the shared daily session pool, matching Pro and Flash. The user-facing availability notice updated to reflect no per-model limits.

1bbdc9e90d4becb32401d13293d9cbd7c9a5841c.title: Add 'imprezia_forced' ad experiment arm for internal team and test accounts
1bbdc9e90d4becb32401d13293d9cbd7c9a5841c.summary: Extended `AdExperimentArm` type with new `'imprezia_forced'` value. Added `isImpreziaAudienceEmail` helper to identify team/test accounts by email domain. Updated `adExperimentArmForUser` to accept optional `userEmail` parameter and route matching users to the forced arm before standard bucketing.

4fa5ea05a929de13ec11d3f1a4549953efa6c09b.title: Enable Placements Console; Add Safety & Routing
4fa5ea05a929de13ec11d3f1a4549953efa6c09b.summary: Placements console enabled with expanded sellable slots. Added ad creative safety sanitization and first-party ad routing logic. Analytics events updated for first-party decisions.

2b718cc3be65d5704cf71390e398c989c1641b84.title: Ad slots, metrics, first-party routing, logging
2b718cc3be65d5704cf71390e398c989c1641b84.summary: Adds Desktop-Below-Chat and Single-Ad-Unit-1 placement slots. Reorders primary/diagnostic metrics, adds avgCpa, changes CTR to use total clicks. First-party ad routing defaults to disabled (opt-in). Adds Axiom logging schemas for first-party decision and settlement events.

1a069f10a6dcb5116116520f285a565bc7e658ac.title: Remove sandbox allowlist check
1a069f10a6dcb5116116520f285a565bc7e658ac.summary: Deleted `isImpreziaSandboxTester` helper. Production sandbox ad serving now relies solely on explicit `allowSandbox` opt-in, removing the email allowlist gate.

ee79648a9e2aff11d54250c2dd488709b9fb3626.title: GPT-5.6 Luna session cap raised to 3
ee79648a9e2aff11d54250c2dd488709b9fb3626.summary: Increased the daily session limit for GPT-5.6 Luna from 2 to 3. Updated the tier change notice to reflect the new cap.

79ca37b5008dc6dfe804a8b7bb002be7d4435abf.title: CLI: tool output extraction, reset time formatting
79ca37b5008dc6dfe804a8b7bb002be7d4435abf.summary: Fixed nested agent block extraction and tool output updates. Added `formatResetTimeLong` for day-inclusive reset times.

4140a604bcff8120f0e60c1cd20258bdbb9e6cd0.title: Fix model selector layout, quota display
4140a604bcff8120f0e60c1cd20258bdbb9e6cd0.summary: Model selector row details unified for correct centering and sizing. Premium quota display now requires server snapshot; no static fallback. Per-row quota chips shown for stricter pools.

95e94c20aecc773fd13da69de9eebff40f6436bb.title: Added Imprezia ad integration and A/B experiment logic
95e94c20aecc773fd13da69de9eebff40f6436bb.summary: New shared modules implement the Imprezia Chat Ads API client, including beacon payload construction and device detection. An A/B experiment utility assigns users to treatment or control arms to test Imprezia as the primary ad provider.

50aa984b714af271946c68a2ed80466a01338c4e.title: Simplify CLI keyboard navigation logic
50aa984b714af271946c68a2ed80466a01338c4e.summary: Refactored slash and mention menu keyboard actions in `cli/src/utils/keyboard-actions.ts`. Logic simplified for handling up/down navigation with history state checks. No user-visible behavior changes.

a23c8b25050c3630473d9be4309c3eaa858cde07.title: Replace Promise.withResolvers with standard Promise
a23c8b25050c3630473d9be4309c3eaa858cde07.summary: Internal refactor in `stream-parser.ts`. Swapped `Promise.withResolvers` for a standard `new Promise` constructor to improve compatibility.

695d4d15676d9937d172ccf87909013085942be1.title: DeepSeek weekday peak hours
695d4d15676d9937d172ccf87909013085942be1.summary: DeepSeek peak hour logic now checks Beijing time, treating weekends as always off-peak. Subscription disclaimers updated to reflect weekday-only restrictions.

41eb6446627cc703eeb8323efaf1e6477204a06d.title: Add Imprezia sandbox tester allowlist
41eb6446627cc703eeb8323efaf1e6477204a06d.summary: New `isImpreziaSandboxTester` helper checks against `IMPREZIA_SANDBOX_TESTERS` env var. `fetchImpreziaChatAd` accepts optional `allowSandbox` flag. Sandbox keys now require explicit opt-in or allowlist entry to serve in production.

5acb86de2a75b3c0a36e2ce451723bf1e5dece38.title: Removed redundant PostHog analytics events
5acb86de2a75b3c0a36e2ce451723bf1e5dece38.summary: Deleted `USER_INPUT_COMPLETE`, `CLI_LOG`, and other high-volume events to reduce noise and cost. Analytics now primarily mirrors to Axiom for debugging, dropping duplicate PostHog tracking for logs and specific backend events.

5a504c380ad0497547ff88e63624d6101795cc92.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro available all day
5a504c380ad0497547ff88e63624d6101795cc92.summary: Removed peak-hour restrictions for DeepSeek V4 Pro. It is now available 24/7 (limited to 1 session/day).

923de567621991a2f4d90fe7bcfcf4fd016a24ca.title: Add ads_fetch_completed operational log allowlist
923de567621991a2f4d90fe7bcfcf4fd016a24ca.summary: Added `ADS_FETCH_COMPLETED_EVENT` to the Axiom-only log allowlist. Defined explicit field schema for ad fetch metadata to ensure strict sanitization without becoming product events.

09f62ecb291de42ee67f62602f769b8f37c79bfb.title: docs: update flake #1899 status, warn dispatcher hypothesis unproven
09f62ecb291de42ee67f62602f769b8f37c79bfb.summary: Docs updated to reflect #1983 un-skipped flaky test via React Testing Library migration. Clarifies fix is theoretical, not diagnostic. #1899 remains open pending CI stability. 12 files still use hand-rolled mount.

990ae116fee764e1daf72f0fda57880cf3d369b7.title: V4 Pro cap removed
990ae116fee764e1daf72f0fda57880cf3d369b7.summary: V4 Pro is uncapped. Luna is only per-model cap. Tier notice updated.

84c46ec290a6e544a29a30189b87a2fa1fa4ec90.title: Pro tier removed from subscription catalog. Disclaimer text updated.
84c46ec290a6e544a29a30189b87a2fa1fa4ec90.summary: Removed the `pro` tier from `FREEBUFF_SUBSCRIPTION_TIER_IDS` and `FREEBUFF_SUBSCRIPTION_TIERS`, making it unreachable via checkout. Updated `freebuffSubscriptionTierDisclaimers` to clarify session limits, rolling windows, and reset behavior without restating numeric caps.

b2efafdc0d4a0bf860ea5dd9581c8d754a664087.title: Add Novita Codex (test) model and provider support
b2efafdc0d4a0bf860ea5dd9581c8d754a664087.summary: Added new god-only model `openai/gpt-5.6-luna-es` (displayed as 'Codex (test)') with 372k context window. Registered `novita` as a spend provider. Internal agent routing updated to support new base2/base3 roots for this model.

098dd053d11a6338dae3f4abd62996a0c18982aa.title: CLI: Refactor implementor helpers
098dd053d11a6338dae3f4abd62996a0c18982aa.summary: Replaced if-else chains with lookup tables and simplified control flow in `implementor-helpers.ts`. No user-facing behavior changes.

28220d571736520903c8e75cfd41a8588cd5e1a0.title: Add GPT-5.6 Luna ES to premium pool; derive god-only IDs
28220d571736520903c8e75cfd41a8588cd5e1a0.summary: Added FREEBUFF_GPT_5_6_LUNA_ES_MODEL_ID to premium model lists. Refactored FREEBUFF_WEB_GOD_ONLY_MODEL_IDS to derive from model objects instead of hardcoding IDs. Updated subscription constants to reflect Kimi K3 Eco's status as a bait model.

ac2a035d604166a86390a7272dd56b60efd8a556.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash default; V4 Pro capped/peak-paused
ac2a035d604166a86390a7272dd56b60efd8a556.summary: DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31 now default model with full access. DeepSeek V4 Pro moved to last position, limited to 1 session/day, and paused during peak hours (00:00-10:00 UTC).

0b697402591b23688e8fff0b8861d7b427190e2e.title: Ad card headline display
0b697402591b23688e8fff0b8861d7b427190e2e.summary: Ad cards now render the advertiser's headline. Prevents duplicate title/CTA text. Layout stays fixed height.

9a9f7dd95b7843187a4048b1b950b3539ab8fd5c.title: Move inline ad layout to shared `common` package
9a9f7dd95b7843187a4048b1b950b3539ab8fd5c.summary: Refactored ad rendering logic by moving `inline-ad-layout.ts` to `common/src/ads/`. This allows the CLI and future web advertiser tools to share exact layout calculations. Added `isServableLandingUrl` for security validation.

b563ba5e6b3bf0de5a76a0d72c354ae3db370210.title: Add x-freebuff-privileged-user header
b563ba5e6b3bf0de5a76a0d72c354ae3db370210.summary: Introduced `x-freebuff-privileged-user` constant for trusted server-to-server communication. It indicates if an acting account holds admin/god roles, verified server-side. Honored only for Freebuff Web service account requests to prevent forgery.

01301385919da16daba8bd458609835c69e31a7e.title: PLACEMENTS_CONSOLE_ENABLED comment update
01301385919da16daba8bd458609835c69e31a7e.summary: Updated docstring for `PLACEMENTS_CONSOLE_ENABLED` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-placements.ts`. Clarified that `FREEBUFF_PLACEMENTS_AUDIENCE` env var now controls console access, while the constant remains a fixture indicator.

a275174b3e37c2e809245dcc06a74e6406b8d8b2.title: Bump version to 0.0.153
a275174b3e37c2e809245dcc06a74e6406b8d8b2.summary: Updated release package version from 0.0.152 to 0.0.153.

7895583a6c3216d4a977080028483c8b65fc9d3d.title: Added AD_RESET_TIMEZONE constant
7895583a6c3216d4a977080028483c8b65fc9d3d.summary: Introduced `AD_RESET_TIMEZONE` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-ads.ts` set to `'America/Los_Angeles'`. This ensures ad spend caps and daily boundaries align with Pacific time, matching existing user quotas.

592d93f5d9e627a00fa4db4e1d1e8ca7662421a0.title: Ad showcase engagement data filled
592d93f5d9e627a00fa4db4e1d1e8ca7662421a0.summary: Updated `AD_SHOWCASE_TWEETS` with actual reposts and views counts for two entries. Clarified that `views` must be stored as raw integers, not abbreviated strings, for consistent rendering.

ed706ca47d476c9a68e7302b22b3c615dd522dd1.title: Default model switches to DeepSeek V4 Pro; Flash pauses at peak
ed706ca47d476c9a68e7302b22b3c615dd522dd1.summary: DeepSeek V4 Pro is now the default full-access model and the only premium row available at all hours. DeepSeek V4 Flash pauses during peak hours, falling back to V4 Pro instead of unlimited models. The 'RECOMMENDED' badge was removed from the model picker, leaving list order as the sole steer.

07685661de57b219d53ab908cf2e2bafcdb3e1eb.title: Update ad showcase tweet stats and documentation
07685661de57b219d53ab908cf2e2bafcdb3e1eb.summary: Refreshed engagement metrics for showcase tweets to exact counts as of August 21, 2026. Updated documentation to specify syndication endpoint for likes/replies and manual analytics steps for reposts/views.

2a3c3c791364d4f39c2c61d80162909cd199cd29.title: Add paid subscription tiers and session entitlement types
2a3c3c791364d4f39c2c61d80162909cd199cd29.summary: Added `freebuff-subscriptions.ts` defining Starter, Plus, and Pro tiers with session limits and pricing. Updated `freebuff-session.ts` with types for subscription usage, tier offers, and entitlement breakdowns.

aefe67a7bd41d1b8cce4e53d39f9e22677aaf630.title: CLI model selector: add nowMs prop for deterministic tests
aefe67a7bd41d1b8cce4e53d39f9e22677aaf630.summary: Added optional `nowMs` prop to `FreebuffModelSelector` to pin the internal clock. This ensures time-dependent availability checks (e.g., V4 Pro) remain stable during CI runs by disabling the `useNow` interval when provided.

9d0e435b3802e4b6b833c1ed349d604e5b804f0d.title: Added Ox Alpha model to Freebuff Web/Cloud
9d0e435b3802e4b6b833c1ed349d604e5b804f0d.summary: Introduced `stealth/ox-alpha` model for Web and Cloud surfaces only. Enforces strict zero-cost pricing fence and explicit `high` reasoning effort to prevent latency spikes. Marked experimental due to anonymous host retention policies.

cbdf5030d0238565dfe2852e8eacc93bfc803b82.title: MiniMax M3 withdrawn from free model picker
cbdf5030d0238565dfe2852e8eacc93bfc803b82.summary: MiniMax M3 is no longer available in the free model picker. Users requesting it receive an explicit `model_unavailable` error with a recommendation for DeepSeek V4 Flash. Existing sessions are allowed to drain without interruption.

105640d21d124ff1dd6a7ccd7df06fffb9a5c34f.title: Gravity Index: New 'provision' Action for Account Creation
105640d21d124ff1dd6a7ccd7df06fffb9a5c34f.summary: Added `provision` action to Gravity Index tool to allow agents to create user accounts and receive credentials directly, replacing manual signup links. Requires explicit `user_consent: true` and uses verified email identity. Internal runtime changes support credential injection and UI state tracking.

b9ace3f9b2782eb321dd299ec9972689f3e08daa.title: Retire policy notice, add ad showcase stats
b9ace3f9b2782eb321dd299ec9972689f3e08daa.summary: Policy update notice ends early on 2026-08-20, hiding banner on marketing pages. Ad showcase tweets now render natively with hardcoded engagement stats, replacing X iframe embeds.

1e69baf9bf0ba91e9f693f1a6942e2b92c880783.title: Fix Git Bash path translation on Windows
1e69baf9bf0ba91e9f693f1a6942e2b92c880783.summary: SDK path utilities now translate Git Bash absolute paths (e.g. `/c/...`) to native Windows format before resolution. Fixes file access failures when agents use MSYS-style paths on Windows.

3f3cb3851705ca43846d8a13c2c12a7ebfe94a38.title: Removed DeepSeek peak-hours spend ceiling reduction logic
3f3cb3851705ca43846d8a13c2c12a7ebfe94a38.summary: Deleted `isDeepSeekPeakHour`, `nextDeepSeekWindowBoundary`, `formatDeepSeekPeakWindowsLocal`, `FREEBUFF_PEAK_LIMIT_NOTICE`, and `FreebuffSpendCeilingPeak`. `resolveFreebuffSpendCeiling` no longer applies peak multipliers or returns `peak` metadata. Session response types dropped `peak` fields.

ffed5e29d2c86da974e22ca462675bb334d3212c.title: Fix directory creation race on Windows cloud filesystems
ffed5e29d2c86da974e22ca462675bb334d3212c.summary: `ensureDirectoryExists` now handles `EEXIST` with retries to prevent failures on slow Windows filesystem drivers. `change-file` tool uses this helper for new directories.

657d06d953134758769d273970853bd370e89c3e.title: AD_PRICING_ENABLED true
657d06d953134758769d273970853bd370e89c3e.summary: AD_PRICING_ENABLED true. Stripe billing active. Campaigns charged.

04e751a97e5f614d12c8165741fdaaf212197531.title: Add flaky test troubleshooting guidance to testing docs
04e751a97e5f614d12c8165741fdaaf212197531.summary: Expanded `docs/testing.md` with a section on handling non-reproducible flakes. Added notes on CI retry visibility and shared global state risks in React tests.

0ce5fb0b7d299ff3a646c2785016dd3287928df3.title: Add CI workflows and issue templates
0ce5fb0b7d299ff3a646c2785016dd3287928df3.summary: Introduced public CI, PR hygiene checks, and structured issue templates for bugs, features, and support. Blank issues disabled; redirects for outages/security. CI now validates builds and smoke tests.

5baa7a52d32ba2ed115a659fa28eed38a4414cef.title: Clarify trust cost write path in constants
5baa7a52d32ba2ed115a659fa28eed38a4414cef.summary: Updated documentation for `FREEBUFF_TRUST_COST_PER_PROMPT` to explain why non-zero costs trigger buffered writes and how zero values bypass the write path.

55402897958a0f19676f33abeb1432e63ea53ca7.title: Update .gitignore
55402897958a0f19676f33abeb1432e63ea53ca7.summary: Added entries for QA fixture data and design-tooling scratch directories to prevent accidental commits.

6c1591f8a5caf4b189e75bea718139d506c0b121.title: Default model changed to DeepSeek V4 Flash; MiniMax M3 unlimited
6c1591f8a5caf4b189e75bea718139d506c0b121.summary: DeepSeek V4 Flash is now the default model in full mode. MiniMax M3 is no longer premium, making it unlimited. GPT-5.6 Luna and DeepSeek V4 Pro now have a one-session daily limit, and V4 Pro is closed during peak hours.

9311890b70d198454df8e25b72df2d064854dc48.title: Clarify model availability reasons & simplify tier notices
9311890b70d198454df8e25b72df2d064854dc48.summary: CLI model selector now displays specific local-time labels for models unavailable due to peak-hour restrictions, replacing silent greying. Shared core logic unified to ensure picker and server agree on availability windows, while tier change notices were condensed for readability.

7b1bde13e85e50fb7f0ca7675ebf8c29788ec464.title: Fix model selector quota display for mixed pools
7b1bde13e85e50fb7f0ca7675ebf8c29788ec464.summary: Added session pool grouping to correctly display quota limits when models in the same section have different rate limits. Updated DeepSeek tier change notice to clarify shared daily session usage.

b4e5713b824dff395fcf7112cfc5ccae94429984.title: Disable ad campaign review
b4e5713b824dff395fcf7112cfc5ccae94429984.summary: Added `AD_CAMPAIGN_REVIEW_ENABLED` flag set to `false`. Campaigns now go live without per-campaign review. Advertiser account approval remains required.

b378f994a87f43adea2fa4fed651663f2b89b08e.title: Disable ad billing, cap free campaigns at 7 days
b378f994a87f43adea2fa4fed651663f2b89b08e.summary: Set `AD_PRICING_ENABLED` to false. Free campaigns auto-marked paid. Enforced max 7-day duration via `resolveCampaignEndDate`. Billing logic preserved for easy re-enable.

08a8371fb064793ba00624c528e8738489aea268.title: Trust cost now flat 1 per prompt
08a8371fb064793ba00624c528e8738489aea268.summary: All models (standard, GLM, premium, frontier) now cost 1 trust point per prompt. Standard model usage no longer free; frontier reduced from 2 to 1. Simplifies cost prediction.

f7bb825f48d23a5e38f2a43748657d567847cd9a.title: Ignore ad-hoc investigation scripts
f7bb825f48d23a5e38f2a43748657d567847cd9a.summary: Added `scripts/_tmp-*` to `.gitignore` to prevent temporary investigation scripts from being committed.

2e3e3f6691f3de16b7b0b5ddcb1612c553a382de.title: Free standard prompts; Trust balance floor at zero
2e3e3f6691f3de16b7b0b5ddcb1612c553a382de.summary: Standard model prompts now cost 0 Trust. GLM, premium, and frontier costs reduced. Negative balances are disabled; existing negative scores are clamped to 0 on read.

7dcb4fb1e09cbd72bb0d86409739ff616bc6d472.title: Web project daily limit reduced to 5; added max open sandboxes
7dcb4fb1e09cbd72bb0d86409739ff616bc6d472.summary: Daily limit for new Web projects reduced from 10 to 5 to prevent resource saturation. New constant `FREEBUFF_WEB_MAX_OPEN_SANDBOXES` limits concurrent running sandboxes per user to 2.

24de8d9513fd0584a4a18a73f3d3ca5e7e54a1bf.title: Auto-prepend https:// to pasted URLs
24de8d9513fd0584a4a18a73f3d3ca5e7e54a1bf.summary: The `normalizeUrlInput` helper now automatically adds the `https://` scheme to URL strings if missing. This fixes silent failures when pasting scheme-less links (e.g., `x.com/...`) into forms. Explicitly wrong schemes like `javascript:` remain untouched to preserve security checks.

b5111f885a8e3b737cffff102f353444ea860ada.title: Add flagged engagement status, showcase configs
b5111f885a8e3b737cffff102f353444ea860ada.summary: Added 'flagged' to AD_ENGAGEMENT_STATUSES to sync with database enum. Introduced AD_ENGAGEMENT_STATUS_LABELS for operator surfaces. Added AD_SHOWCASE_POST_URLS and AD_SHOWCASE_REACH constants for landing page proof points.

c8ad1e274f4ab909d17fd050698c542d99ec3b63.title: Model Catalog Update: DeepSeek V4 Pro, Tier Notices, Planner Changes
c8ad1e274f4ab909d17fd050698c542d99ec3b63.summary: DeepSeek V4 Pro replaced DeepSeek V4 Pro 08/13 in the free model picker. CLI landing screen now shows tier-specific notices for full and limited access. Shared constants updated to reflect planner model convergence on the unlimited model.

ba0e40bacf53a1ffa8dfcf0db6ab7b0da43b139a.title: Fix ad impression mismatch and update Chrome UA version
ba0e40bacf53a1ffa8dfcf0db6ab7b0da43b139a.summary: Updated the simulated Chrome user agent version from 124 to 151 to avoid bot filtering. Added `resolveAdProviderUserAgent` to ensure the ad auction and impression pixel report the same browser-like user agent, preventing mismatches between client and server signals.

8c034b5f9242c0bb48b8021f96eeb2e159096d16.title: Stricter LinkedIn comment URL validation
8c034b5f9242c0bb48b8021f96eeb2e159096d16.summary: Updated ad evidence attestation text to explicitly require liking, reposting, and commenting. LinkedIn comment URL checks now reject links to the post itself, enforcing consistent validation across platforms.

e73d39fff1ab55bc2c2615d60efd7129afa5c7fc.title: CLI referral banner now links to Earn Trust tab with unified copy
e73d39fff1ab55bc2c2615d60efd7129afa5c7fc.summary: The CLI referral banner now links to `/earn/trust` instead of the referral tab, ensuring users are directed to the fastest way to earn sessions. The call-to-action text is unified across CLI, Desktop, and browser surfaces via shared constants.

35dc6d079403192cc19e9552f4a951fa9776f707.title: Fix skill loading on shared hosts
35dc6d079403192cc19e9552f4a951fa9776f707.summary: Skill loading now respects an explicit opt-in flag for searching the host's home directory. This prevents the agent from accidentally loading skills from the server's `~/.agents/skills` or `~/.claude/skills` paths when running in sandboxed or multi-tenant environments.

187b1e916c06bd3ab87208ac647577fb4b9f6b03.title: Switch ad billing to daily subscription model
187b1e916c06bd3ab87208ac647577fb4b9f6b03.summary: Updated ad billing logic to charge advertisers a flat daily subscription rate instead of metering per engagement. `AD_ENGAGEMENT_PRICE_CENTS` now acts as a divisor to calculate delivery caps, not a billed line item.

aaf1843ce840d29bf339feae4644adf3df1e06c9.title: Ignore scratch-* files at root
aaf1843ce840d29bf339feae4644adf3df1e06c9.summary: Added `scratch-*` pattern to `.gitignore`. Prevents accidental commit of temporary helper scripts located at the repository root.

fad014c575a497df9a3169fb2bc516281a081a58.title: Remove obsolete comment from SDK constants
fad014c575a497df9a3169fb2bc516281a081a58.summary: Deleted a placeholder `// todo` comment and extra whitespace in `sdk/src/constants.ts`. No functional changes to the SDK.

01ea6aba4c679543e05913a5db8faa49937b13c0.title: Add Luminal provider to spend constants
01ea6aba4c679543e05913a5db8faa49937b13c0.summary: Added 'luminal' to SPEND_PROVIDER_IDS and mapped it to 'Luminal' in PROVIDER_LABELS.

cef358330ebed218abe3c1d8df88a8d4bb8315db.title: Fix free mode admission for limited tier substituted models
cef358330ebed218abe3c1d8df88a8d4bb8315db.summary: Added `isLimitedTierSubstitutedModel` to allow free mode when the server substitutes `LIMITED_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID` for models that left the limited tier. Prevents incorrect metered billing for accounts with no balance.

1470aa4e189c2d0347843109e5ec86dbab395402.title: DB health alerts run without pg_read_all_stats
1470aa4e189c2d0347843109e5ec86dbab395402.summary: Removed hard privilege gate that disabled alerts. Now synthesizes opaque statement buckets and reports coverage gaps.

5f72959fab4202f5b667112c914282bcc195fb9b.title: Local context token counting, home skills opt-in, skill parser moved to common
5f72959fab4202f5b667112c914282bcc195fb9b.summary: Context token counts now use a local GPT-4o tokenizer instead of the Anthropic API, removing per-step network overhead. CLI opts into `includeHomeSkills` so global `~/.agents/skills` load correctly. `parseSkillFileContent` moved to `common` to avoid tree-sitter WASM crashes in serverless environments.

7129d45870e6486850aca5729015b555653ca7d1.title: Add ad marketplace constants, change free session limits
7129d45870e6486850aca5729015b555653ca7d1.summary: Added new constants for the advertiser marketplace, including pricing, platform actions, and campaign lifecycle states. README updated: limited access now 3 one-hour sessions per day, earnable up to 7.

bdc6b61fb93d720c2e1dbc084046eec16580336f.title: Reduce premium session limit to 5
bdc6b61fb93d720c2e1dbc084046eec16580336f.summary: The `FREEBUFF_PREMIUM_SESSION_LIMIT` constant was decreased from 6 to 5. This reduces the number of free premium sessions available per user.

89832d9b3ade452149cf8e9658bd4537107fc5e7.title: Peak-hour spend reductions now apply only to DeepSeek-capable tiers
89832d9b3ade452149cf8e9658bd4537107fc5e7.summary: Updated spend ceiling logic to skip peak-hour reductions for access tiers that do not include DeepSeek models. This ensures users on tiers like `limited` (which currently only runs MiMo) are not penalized during DeepSeek's peak windows.

d20038cb58001e360bbcfb30960817b202e8993a.title: Add spend provider constants
d20038cb58001e360bbcfb30960817b202e8993a.summary: New file `common/src/constants/spend-providers.ts` defines billing provider IDs, labels, and helpers for spend dashboards. Distinguishes model vendor from billing counterparty.

9b9b25e76714ba3cfc7fff9a8b13428164cdc2cf.title: Update Desktop service path references in constants
9b9b25e76714ba3cfc7fff9a8b13428164cdc2cf.summary: Updated file path references in shared constants from `autorun.ts` to `mission.ts` to reflect the Desktop service rename.

8da51dc0eaecae13822690e91ea90a9038bd9dc6.title: Limited access now defaults to MiMo 2.5
8da51dc0eaecae13822690e91ea90a9038bd9dc6.summary: DeepSeek V4 Flash removed from limited access; MiMo 2.5 becomes default. CLI displays paused model notices.

695a52ed5a16bd3c3482682e2f84b29ac47c5190.title: Spend ceiling docs clarify 2x hard cap for restricted cohorts
695a52ed5a16bd3c3482682e2f84b29ac47c5190.summary: Updated `freebuff-spend-ceilings.ts` comments to explain enforcement nuances. Restricted-risk cohorts now face a 2x hard cap on live reclaims and new prompts, while internal accounts are exempt. Desktop reclaim admission skips spend gating, but prompts enforce the cap.

d0c7b069051a45044d107598a2ce98ef80d63100.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro repricing
d0c7b069051a45044d107598a2ce98ef80d63100.summary: DeepSeek repriced V4 Pro family with peak/off-peak cards. Pro now costs more than Luna across all terms. Default model unchanged.

35eec19e84f06cc0bfef213d204165ac1e9867a4.title: DeepSeek peak-hours ceiling reduction + user notice
35eec19e84f06cc0bfef213d204165ac1e9867a4.summary: Added `freebuff-peak-hours.ts` defining DeepSeek peak windows (01-04, 06-10 UTC) and local-time formatting. Spend ceilings now optionally apply a peak multiplier with `endsAt` tracking. Session responses include `peak` metadata to distinguish temporary caps from daily resets.

6c49e12dc09c72d510ee13940ea543ef19b418e5.title: Fix Desktop Auto-Run 402 Credit Error
6c49e12dc09c72d510ee13940ea543ef19b418e5.summary: Added `freebuff-desktop-autorun` to free-mode root agents. Previously, auto-run decisions fell through to metered path, causing "Out of credits" errors and preventing next-step generation for free users.

c200e2d4f1c2dbc77bdd889971d83fb755fb0f53.title: Add DB health alert shared logic
c200e2d4f1c2dbc77bdd889971d83fb755fb0f53.summary: New `common/src/util/db-health-alerts.ts` module provides shared SQL queries and threshold evaluation for database health monitoring. Includes logic for wraparound, backend_xmin, invalid indexes, and busy-backend detection, plus permission probes.

2afc2b2dfac9a0bcb48e18ccc0c1f720f6f2e6a7.title: Fix silent stream errors, unpin Luna routing
2afc2b2dfac9a0bcb48e18ccc0c1f720f6f2e6a7.summary: Reordered Zod union schemas to prioritize error branches, preventing provider errors from being stripped as empty streams. Updated Luna model routing to use price-fenced fallbacks instead of a hard OpenAI pin.

2fa82f2e26c68a2e750dcdd3515855e661d05577.title: Add shared UTC day helpers
2fa82f2e26c68a2e750dcdd3515855e661d05577.summary: New `utc-days.ts` module centralizes UTC date string math (`shiftUtcDay`, `todayUtc`, `dayWindowBounds`, `trailingUtcDays`) previously duplicated across rollup scripts and dashboards. Prevents drift and off-by-one errors in window boundary calculations.

eb2eb5ec4b15f2b31cee2ff7c6870aef398526aa.title: Remove NEXT_PUBLIC_HUMANBEHAVIOR_INGESTION_URL from client env
eb2eb5ec4b15f2b31cee2ff7c6870aef398526aa.summary: Dropped `NEXT_PUBLIC_HUMANBEHAVIOR_INGESTION_URL` from `clientEnvSchema` and `clientProcessEnv`. The SDK's default ingestion host is now the only supported configuration. This is a breaking change for deployments that relied on the override.

192cb715a3ae26a1deee15731d0ddd86560fe262.title: Add desktop login-started analytics
192cb715a3ae26a1deee15731d0ddd86560fe262.summary: Added `DESKTOP_LOGIN_STARTED` to track sign-in attempts. Included in always-track list to preserve funnel conversion accuracy.

095d6d65a1697d4cb31e0a39df9adeafcf7946c2.title: Freebuff Desktop 移除 Beta 标签
095d6d65a1697d4cb31e0a39df9adeafcf7946c2.summary: README 文档中 Freebuff Desktop 不再标记为 Beta。中英文版本均已同步更新。

ae35b542f1b2cc0e6e455ef9effa1cdb9ad4c818.title: SG spend cap raised $0.50 to $5. New budget refusal copy.
ae35b542f1b2cc0e6e455ef9effa1cdb9ad4c818.summary: Singapore moved from restricted to new elevated $5 tier. Domain-based farm blocking replaces geographic cap. Plain 'used all free usage' message for budget limits.

2d370c194f127b56a4273462587f7589a557b834.title: Fix tool message media buffering to prevent validation errors
2d370c194f127b56a4273462587f7589a557b834.summary: Implemented media buffering in `convertToolMessages` to ensure images are emitted only after all parallel tool calls are answered. This prevents client-side validation failures that previously wedged threads replaying history.

f97ca5511b01eba2552e9be7d7332194f5118ca3.title: Stop pricing mainstream privacy emails
f97ca5511b01eba2552e9be7d7332194f5118ca3.summary: Proton, Apple, and Firefox Relay domains removed from spend ceiling. New `mainstream_privacy` classification keeps visibility without penalizing users.

5db7a544be7c5ec414b833a4cb295fa8511b1b8c.title: Hard spend cap + unverified egress ceiling
5db7a544be7c5ec414b833a4cb295fa8511b1b8c.summary: Adds hard spend multiplier for small ceilings to limit live session overshoot. Introduces unverified_egress reason and skipped provider statuses to prevent vendor outages from widening budgets.

6eb9bf8e4038d432a370d0186b0d124fe912fabe.title: SDK: drop half-step tool calls on checkpoint resume
6eb9bf8e4038d432a370d0186b0d124fe912fabe.summary: Checkpoint persistence now filters unanswered tool calls from history. Prevents structural errors when resuming runs that interrupted mid-tool-call.

09e160095a84086726021f1c614790d8558f8ca5.title: Add reCAPTCHA v2/v3 client env vars and distinct block reasons
09e160095a84086726021f1c614790d8558f8ca5.summary: New optional environment variables NEXT_PUBLIC_RECAPTCHA_V2_SITE_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_RECAPTCHA_V3_SITE_KEY, and NEXT_PUBLIC_RECAPTCHA_V2_SIZE added to client schema. Signup block reasons split captcha_* from recaptcha_* to distinguish Cloudflare Turnstile from Google reCAPTCHA failures in logs and user messages.

43db7ec34405a23491b376662bf243226a136619.title: Remove internal database request cost tracking utility
43db7ec34405a23491b376662bf243226a136619.summary: Deleted `common/src/util/database-request-cost.ts`. This internal module handled Axiom APL query generation and budget evaluation for database performance monitoring. No user-facing changes.

0029f0a29f01837307120b1212694ffaa2899474.title: Restricted spend ceiling lowered to $0.50; privacy egress now restricted
0029f0a29f01837307120b1212694ffaa2899474.summary: Daily spend ceiling for restricted accounts lowered from $1.00 to $0.50. Requests arriving over anonymizing egress (VPN, proxy, Tor) now trigger the restricted ceiling.

9c97c4b81c451b11472f72068b175d485a9512a8.title: Fix withTimeout resource leak
9c97c4b81c451b11472f72068b175d485a9512a8.summary: Refactored `withTimeout` to use `try/finally` for clearing timeouts. Prevents lingering timer resources when the promise resolves or rejects.

871d75810e6732f65067d4bd6faec927c529332d.title: Per-account daily spend ceilings replace flat $50 cap
871d75810e6732f65067d4bd6faec927c529332d.summary: New `freebuff-spend-ceilings.ts` defines per-account daily spend limits based on region, email domain, client type, and trust level. Ceilings compose by minimum, ensuring the lowest applicable limit is enforced. Restricted cohorts (SG/CN, disposable domains, third-party clients) are capped at $1/day instead of banned.

c6d10a5bff56b7a83bd09e507bc5adc2a373c8dc.title: Add data collection Q&A copy
c6d10a5bff56b7a83bd09e507bc5adc2a373c8dc.summary: Added `collectionQuestion` and `collectionAnswer` to `FREEBUFF_PUBLIC_DATA_USE_COPY`. Clarifies that Freebuff does not collect traces/files unless model provider does (currently DeepSeek).

6e27bb24543eadf602931a09a003526915b1509c.title: Shared capacity refusal copy
6e27bb24543eadf602931a09a003526915b1509c.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_CAPACITY_NOTICE` constant. Single string for all spend-ceiling refusals. Prevents leaking detection signals; omits specific caps.

7c219be7ef6d60e088fcfa9fcd566a798153d57b.title: Clarify restricted account notice
7c219be7ef6d60e088fcfa9fcd566a798153d57b.summary: Updated refusal message for accounts flagged for VPN, restricted locations, or bot-farm email domains. Explains causes and suggests disabling VPN to restore normal limits.

ad5d3005fb7f08e572e6fe8323303b26497795e1.title: Add analytics events for thread archiving and conflict transitions
ad5d3005fb7f08e572e6fe8323303b26497795e1.summary: Added `DESKTOP_THREADS_AUTO_ARCHIVED` and `DESKTOP_DELIVERY_CONFLICT_CHANGED` to the analytics event enum to track background lifecycle outcomes. These events are bucketed and emitted only on transitions to prevent high cardinality.

cef314aab409b9198cc4f5665e4a52da528c4eb4.title: Referral banner links to specific tab
cef314aab409b9198cc4f5665e4a52da528c4eb4.summary: Updated Freebuff referral banner to link directly to the referral status tab instead of the general Earn page. Changed button label to 'Open referral status'.

204d98237e29a1004f52c2d7d6beac9cfbb9f694.title: Fix image URL handling for plain string URLs and existing data: URIs
204d98237e29a1004f52c2d7d6beac9cfbb9f694.summary: The image URL conversion now accepts plain string URLs, not just URL instances. It also correctly skips re-prefixing strings that already contain a `data:` or `http(s)://` scheme, preventing double-encoded base64 errors.

7db20c99a59d3ee3b410142d90b0f781f3861cc3.title: Bump CLI version to 0.0.149
7db20c99a59d3ee3b410142d90b0f781f3861cc3.summary: Updated package version in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` from 0.0.148 to 0.0.149.

190ac96c3428bfbd1ea3ffbdeaf77659f088a902.title: Clipboard copy reliability: OSC 52 fallback & abort stale copies
190ac96c3428bfbd1ea3ffbdeaf77659f088a902.summary: CLI clipboard copy now uses native tools first, falling back to OSC 52 with bounded rendering for large transcripts. Stale copy operations are aborted when new selections occur, preventing race conditions.

1fca3e29a75dddac2d4b2fc694f8f13a42b51253.title: Remove <user_message> XML wrapping from user messages
1fca3e29a75dddac2d4b2fc694f8f13a42b51253.summary: User messages are no longer wrapped in `<user_message>` XML tags. The agent now identifies user inputs via message tags instead of parsing XML content.

a801ecf452f6262853055d6aafb484bf3a74ec3c.title: Update GPT-5.6 Luna tagline
a801ecf452f6262853055d6aafb484bf3a74ec3c.summary: Changed GPT-5.6 Luna tagline to 'Strong all-around' to better reflect its general-purpose premium positioning.

8057a82e406417ae68791f4ca8e5e26bb812be03.title: Deemphasized model list emptied
8057a82e406417ae68791f4ca8e5e26bb812be03.summary: Internal constant `FREEBUFF_WEB_DEEMPHASIZED_MODEL_IDS` now empty. MiniMax M3 removed from muted list due to UI rendering issues with single entries. Luna remains unmuted as cost comparison with Pro is inconclusive.

80bc9c895dd73f9996ae18af67432e9ae1b09181.title: Fix orphan tool calls poisoning thread history
80bc9c895dd73f9996ae18af67432e9ae1b09181.summary: Move tool-call filtering to shared core. Drop unanswered calls before user/system boundary. Prevent permanent thread corruption.

c0e5740f4ee47c3c7dd3fe6f890b2fc5b26b34d7.title: llm-providers: ai dep moved to devDependencies; image file data handling
c0e5740f4ee47c3c7dd3fe6f890b2fc5b26b34d7.summary: Moved `ai` from runtime dependency to devDependency in `packages/llm-providers/package.json`. Added `imageUrlFromData` helper in `convert-to-openai-compatible-chat-messages.ts` to support AI SDK 7 tagged file data shapes (v4 `type: 'data'` / `type: 'url'`) and accept `mediaType === 'image'`.

c7ddc18ceedc4938f6df6f859c14e98de8ad0562.title: Reorder model picker: DeepSeek V4 Pro leads
c7ddc18ceedc4938f6df6f859c14e98de8ad0562.summary: The model catalog in the picker now lists DeepSeek V4 Pro 08/13 first, followed by DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31. This aligns the displayed order with the current default model.

fc178cb1ef7c7d06ee0bf55e88a7b6415f2cb291.title: Remove onboarding bypass cookie constants
fc178cb1ef7c7d06ee0bf55e88a7b6415f2cb291.summary: Deleted `ONBOARDING_BYPASS_COOKIE` and `ONBOARDING_BYPASS_TTL_SECONDS` constants. Removes the escape hatch mechanism for onboarding failures.

79d6a9de6e44b00e4d484725b74991122ae257ab.title: CLI default harness switched to base3
79d6a9de6e44b00e4d484725b74991122ae257ab.summary: Changed `CLI_HARNESS` constant from `base2` to `base3`, routing DEFAULT, LITE, and all Freebuff picker models to the new base3 agent roots. Updated `freebuff-agent-selection.ts` to expose `getFreebuffCliAgentIdForModel` for this logic. Adjusted `free-agents.ts` comments to reflect current model availability differences between Web and CLI surfaces.

df226b46771c1d64d1f4fd9f7e11e7996e47cba5.title: Add DeepSeek/GPT-5.6 extended context tiers
df226b46771c1d64d1f4fd9f7e11e7996e47cba5.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_PROVISIONED_MODELS` constant defining extended context variants for DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash and GPT-5.6 Luna. These rows are internal-only, excluded from public catalogs and quota lists to prevent client rendering errors. CLI version bumped to 0.0.148.

a0a9a4c80ae8b8aba38b449aa29ad9e214633c43.title: Extended-context model variants added to core constants
a0a9a4c80ae8b8aba38b449aa29ad9e214633c43.summary: Added wire IDs and root agent mappings for DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash and Luna `-max` tiers. These variants are provisioned per-account and excluded from public client catalogs.

603b0d994dece07838c774cb022529dee7a28f1d.title: CLI: streak dots revert to ●/○, focus style change
603b0d994dece07838c774cb022529dee7a28f1d.summary: CLI streak progress glyphs revert to `●`/`○` for consistency. Focus state on dashboard button now uses bold accent color instead of `▶ ` marker to prevent layout shift.

7ef9669a46ffdb16f461c281a67ac52e4d3b9560.title: Docs: Add file order flake guide
7ef9669a46ffdb16f461c281a67ac52e4d3b9560.summary: Added section on file order flakes in `docs/testing.md`. Explains `global-jsdom` module-scope caching issues. Provided reproduction steps and two rules for safe global restoration.

0d865059f023cea0d49fd9dce302ed1762f196c8.title: Onboarding required; bypass only on save failure
0d865059f023cea0d49fd9dce302ed1762f196c8.summary: Onboarding form now requires every question answered. Unanswered questions trigger validation errors. Bypass cookie (`fb_onboarding_bypass`) set only after save failures, with 24h TTL.

d9ee7bfc3e52b9156522bc86250fc7376f9fe955.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro 08/13 becomes default model in full mode
d9ee7bfc3e52b9156522bc86250fc7376f9fe955.summary: DeepSeek V4 Pro 08/13 is now the default model for all platforms in full-access mode. DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31 remains the default for limited mode. The model selector updates its hero logic to prioritize Pro, falling back to Flash if the premium pool is exhausted.

98e174e577d764b45973ff8a4091cb3b3d6196d8.title: Add `/dashboard` command for usage and streak view
98e174e577d764b45973ff8a4091cb3b3d6196d8.summary: New CLI command `/dashboard` opens the web account hub. It displays streaks, activity maps, and token usage. Aliases include `/usage`, `/stats`, and `/streak`.

42f9dcb2036fe5685daf5f73da59512789e1f5c8.title: Bump version to 0.0.147
42f9dcb2036fe5685daf5f73da59512789e1f5c8.summary: Incremented the package version from 0.0.146 to 0.0.147 in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json`.

e43fdc88870d851ec92b669dbba00bd5ffe17d0d.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro 08/13 replaces GPT-5.6 Luna as default Web/Cloud model
e43fdc88870d851ec92b669dbba00bd5ffe17d0d.summary: The default model for Web, Cloud, and Chat surfaces switched from GPT-5.6 Luna to DeepSeek V4 Pro 08/13. GPT-5.6 Luna remains selectable but now displays a 'superseded' notice recommending the switch. Rate-limit fallbacks for Muse Spark also updated to route to DeepSeek V4 Pro.

c1ff21d02571b1a923041ad489802f64a1514bca.title: Session API adds `standing` field to pre-join response
c1ff21d02571b1a923041ad489802f64a1514bca.summary: The `/api/v1/freebuff/session` pre-join response now includes a `standing` field of type `FreebuffStandingInfo`. This field exposes the account's Access Level and associated limits, enabling clients to display this information alongside the model picker.

bab9f2907dff6c3f090b3ba645f64c91e95e997e.title: Add subscription question, scale UI, legacy mapping
bab9f2907dff6c3f090b3ba645f64c91e95e997e.summary: Added a new multi-select question asking about current or cancelled AI coding subscriptions. Proficiency question now renders as a slider scale. Referral, role, and intended use options were broadened or reworded, with legacy mappings added to preserve historical analytics data.

a5b6b0cf4ef9fbf7f6cf529e803601f243cd1b0f.title: Increase project creation limits, clarify concurrency cap
a5b6b0cf4ef9fbf7f6cf529e803601f243cd1b0f.summary: Raised daily project creation limits for limited-tier web users (3 to 10) and blank cloud projects (5 to 10) to prevent lockouts from failed builds. Documented the single concurrent running project cap, noting that raising it requires multi-session support on the web.

477475a9e9f4723ccff8403fd2b739bf68b87c42.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro 08/13 GA build replaces preview
477475a9e9f4723ccff8403fd2b739bf68b87c42.summary: The free model picker now serves DeepSeek V4 Pro 08/13, replacing the previous V4 Pro build. This update aligns the context window to 1M tokens and standardizes reasoning effort levels with V4 Flash.

d0a5d3f4e4a0caaee723ea2e10499a9c3b64b0fc.title: Bump version to 0.0.146
d0a5d3f4e4a0caaee723ea2e10499a9c3b64b0fc.summary: Updated package version in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` from 0.0.145 to 0.0.146.

fe30ebff1d8856788874e037cf2b741f95b6ead3.title: CLI shows onboarding prompt for new accounts
fe30ebff1d8856788874e037cf2b741f95b6ead3.summary: New Freebuff accounts must complete a short web onboarding questionnaire before using free mode. The CLI now detects this requirement and displays a clear message directing users to finish setup at freebuff.com. Existing accounts are exempt.

b07e38d987cc4aa41a1c0fea1a2502a462f0f50f.title: Onboarding now optional web redirect, CLI gate removed
b07e38d987cc4aa41a1c0fea1a2502a462f0f50f.summary: Onboarding no longer blocks CLI, desktop, or cloud usage. A new web redirect asks users once, with a Skip button. Existing accounts are no longer exempt by cutover date.

364433c460916d2de22bf35956dfa0f9f5e8edff.title: Fix DeepSeek reasoning effort ladders, add native models
364433c460916d2de22bf35956dfa0f9f5e8edff.summary: Corrected DeepSeek V4 Flash/Pro effort mappings to native provider settings. Removed prompt-based effort fallbacks for DeepSeek. Updated GPT-5.6 Luna, Fable 5, and MiniMax M3 effort ladders. Added `EFFORTS_THROUGH_MAX` constant.

c235ded0aec8696b8af0e9fbb9e7fe1529e8bf1f.title: Click queue preview or title to open queue panel
c235ded0aec8696b8af0e9fbb9e7fe1529e8bf1f.summary: New ClickableTitleBox component. Chat input queue preview and Queue panel titles are now clickable to toggle panel visibility. Queue rows support mouse click to edit.

3a66664e54bc6ebb3dcc9dd073e45769a85d045f.title: Fix Linux binary build failure for musl targets
3a66664e54bc6ebb3dcc9dd073e45769a85d045f.summary: Updated build script to resolve and bundle both glibc and musl OpenTUI native packages on Linux. Prevents build failures caused by missing `-linux-x64-musl` and `-linux-arm64-musl` dependencies.

44212cc2816aedc01e2239edb193a18909727871.title: Freebuff: 402/usage errors show 'on us' message
44212cc2816aedc01e2239edb193a18909727871.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_PROVIDER_USAGE_MESSAGE` for provider billing failures (402 or regex match). Prevents free users from seeing credit-purchase flows when upstream providers run out.

4da4570dc9d90c75467c5d5541882cd919481bf0.title: Add optional Human Behavior session-replay env vars
4da4570dc9d90c75467c5d5541882cd919481bf0.summary: Added `NEXT_PUBLIC_HUMANBEHAVIOR_API_KEY` and `NEXT_PUBLIC_HUMANBEHAVIOR_INGESTION_URL` to the client environment schema. Both are optional to allow local development without session replay.

84f4ca34cd7481a4d5bc577ebf5d7343b385650a.title: CLI: Referral banner layout, dashboard button, ad CTA color
84f4ca34cd7481a4d5bc577ebf5d7343b385650a.summary: Referral banner now groups the copy-link and dashboard buttons on one row, with a fixed-width dashboard button and width-aware stacking threshold (62→70). The bounty pitch line was replaced by a promo-only line shown when a GLM promo is active. Ad banner CTA text color now uses a shared `INVERTED_CTA_FG` constant.

b9810f1556b1ad235441f5bea1278b948d119973.title: Signup refusal copy
b9810f1556b1ad235441f5bea1278b948d119973.summary: New shared constants for signup block reasons and user messages. Decouples copy from auth server code to keep client bundles light.

90ca26c0745bcbbcd40ea7ac385c031977d328cc.title: Add CF Worker egress detection constants
90ca26c0745bcbbcd40ea7ac385c031977d328cc.summary: New internal constants and logic for detecting Cloudflare Worker egress to prevent token resale. Includes pure detection function, evidence types, and allowlist parsing.

a6f9f6f9f36afe33900b80d4df2d61d646a8460f.title: Add usage incomplete signal and reasoning token tracking
a6f9f6f9f36afe33900b80d4df2d61d646a8460f.summary: New `onUsageIncomplete` callback fires when model streams abort or fail to provide exact usage receipts. `CacheDebugUsageData` now includes optional `reasoningOutputTokens`. SDK exposes `onUsageIncomplete` in `RunOptions`.
